generic.Defined scope/population: All broker indication requests cleared for a go decision and awaiting an indicative range communication.
generic.In-scope period: From the go decision on the indication record to the stated indication validity date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Indicative low and high premium, validity date, caveat line and submission requirements present in the message.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of indications sent in CRM equals count of go decisions on the workstation indication log.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sent indication document and CRM activity retained with send timestamp and document version number.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Indications sent without a caveat or validity date are logged and dispositioned by a corrected reissue.
generic.Test population: Outbound indication activities logged against broker opportunity records in CRM for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any issued indication states a single firm premium or omits the indication-only caveat line.
generic.Exception handling path: A missing caveat or validity date returns to the Underwriter for corrected reissue within one business day.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Indication issued as a range with caveat, validity date and submission requirements, logged to the opportunity.
generic.Evidence location: CRM broker opportunity activity record with the issued indication document attached.

steps.title: Open the broker opportunity record in CRM (Salesforce/Dynamics)
sop: Search CRM by broker name and producer code to locate the opportunity behind the indication request.
Confirm the account is the correct insured and that the indication request is still open.
Done when the correct broker opportunity record is open and confirmed as the indication target.
verify: Check the opportunity broker, producer code and insured name against the indication request.
Pass when the open CRM opportunity matches the insured and broker on the indication record.

steps.title: Draft the indication message from the approved template in Broker & Agent Portal
sop: Open the Broker & Agent Portal message composer against the linked account.
Select the approved indicative pricing template rather than free-typing a message.
Address the message to the requesting broker contact held on the account.
Done when a draft indication message exists on the portal from the approved template.
verify: Confirm the draft uses the approved template identifier and not a personal mailbox draft.
Pass when the draft is on the portal against the account and uses the approved template.

steps.title: Insert the indicative premium range and validity date into the draft
sop: Copy the low and high band from the indicative rating run output rather than typing a figure.
State the range in the body of the message with the currency and rating basis.
Enter the indication validity date consistent with the expiry held on the indication record.
Done when the draft shows a premium range and a validity date.
verify: Compare the low and high values in the draft to the rating run output referenced on the record.
Confirm the validity date in the draft equals the expiry date on the indication record.
Pass when the range and validity date in the draft match the indication record.

steps.title: Add the indication-only caveat and submission requirement list to the draft
sop: Insert the standard indication only - not a quote caveat line verbatim.
List the full submission items required to convert the indication into a formal quote.
State that formal underwriting and authority checks still apply.
Done when caveat and submission requirement list both appear in the draft.
verify: Read the draft for the caveat line and count the listed submission requirements.
Pass when the caveat is present verbatim and at least the mandatory submission items are listed.

steps.title: Send the indication to the broker through Broker & Agent Portal
sop: Attach the indication document to the portal message before sending.
Send from the account team mailbox rather than a personal mailbox.
Capture the portal send confirmation reference.
Done when the portal records the message as delivered to the broker contact.
verify: Open the portal sent items and confirm the message and attachment against the broker contact.
Pass when the portal shows the indication delivered with the document attached.

steps.title: Log the outbound indication activity on the CRM opportunity
sop: Create an outbound activity on the CRM opportunity recording date, channel and recipient.
Attach the issued indication document to the activity.
Record the stated validity date on the opportunity so the diary can be driven from it.
Done when the CRM activity exists with the indication document attached.
verify: Reopen the CRM activity and confirm the attachment opens and matches the sent document.
Confirm the recorded validity date equals the date stated in the sent message.
Pass when the logged activity carries the correct document and validity date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every indication record raised for the line before the indication document is released to the broker.
generic.In-scope period: From indication record creation to the stated validity expiry date carried on the record.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Non-binding status flag, validity period and indication expiry date all populated on the record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of open indication records equals count flagged Non-binding with a populated expiry date.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Workstation record version and the caveated document retained with the status-change timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Indications found carrying a bindable effective date are logged and cleared before the document is released.
generic.Test population: Indication records created in the underwriting workstation during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any indication lacks the Non-binding flag or carries a bindable coverage effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: Records failing the status check return to the Underwriter to reset status before the indication is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Status is Non-binding, expiry date is populated and the caveat paragraph appears inside the document itself.
generic.Evidence location: Indication record in the underwriting workstation and the linked policy administration system submission.

steps.title: Open the indication record in the underwriting workstation
sop: Locate the indication by account name or indication reference in the workstation.
Confirm the record is still at indication stage and not converted to a submission.
Done when the indication record is open at indication stage.
verify: Check the record type and stage shown on the workstation header.
Pass when the open record is an indication and not a bindable submission.

steps.title: Set the indication status to Non-binding in the underwriting workstation
sop: Select Non-binding from the controlled status list on the indication record.
Save the record so the status change is stamped with user and time.
Done when the workstation status field reads Non-binding.
verify: Reopen the record and read the status field and its change stamp.
Pass when status is Non-binding with a recorded user and timestamp.

steps.title: Enter the validity period and expiry date on the indication record
sop: Enter the agreed validity period for the line, typically 30 days from issue.
Let the workstation derive the expiry date or key it to match the stated period.
Done when both validity period and expiry date are populated on the record.
verify: Recalculate the expiry date from issue date plus validity period.
Pass when the stored expiry date equals issue date plus the stated validity period.

steps.title: Clear any bindable coverage effective date on the policy administration system submission
sop: Open the linked submission in the policy administration system.
Remove or leave blank any coverage effective date that would allow the record to be bound.
Confirm the submission cannot progress to a bind transaction from its current state.
Done when no bindable coverage effective date is held against the indication.
verify: Inspect the effective date field and the available transaction actions on the submission.
Pass when the effective date is empty and no bind action is offered.

steps.title: Insert the standard non-binding caveat paragraph into the indication document
sop: Open the indication document generated from the workstation template.
Confirm the standard non-binding caveat paragraph appears verbatim in the document body.
State the expiry date inside the document, not only in the covering message.
Done when the caveat and expiry date appear in the document itself.
verify: Compare the caveat wording in the document to the approved standard paragraph.
Pass when the caveat is verbatim and the document carries the expiry date.

steps.title: Attach the caveated indication document to the workstation record
sop: Upload the final caveated document against the indication record.
Name the file with the account name, indication reference and version.
Done when the caveated document is attached to the indication record.
verify: Open the attachment from the record and check the caveat and expiry date are present.
Pass when the attached document version carries both the caveat and the expiry date.

generic.Defined scope/population: All broker indication requests awaiting a data sufficiency decision before indicative rating is attempted.
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of the indication request to the recorded sufficiency decision on the indication record.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Insured legal name, address, class code, requested limits, exposure basis and loss history fields completed.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Number of rated sections equals number of sections with a supplied exposure basis value.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Data sufficiency checklist saved against the indication record with reviewer name and check date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each missing mandatory data item is logged as a gap note with chase or insufficient disposition.
generic.Test population: Indication records with a sufficiency decision recorded during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any mandatory field is blank without an explicit recorded gap note explaining the omission.
generic.Exception handling path: Insufficient data routes back to the broker via the portal with a listed data request before rating proceeds.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every mandatory field is ticked or carries a gap note and a sufficient or insufficient decision is recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Data sufficiency checklist attached to the indication record in the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Open the broker submission pack in Broker & Agent Portal
sop: Open the indication request and download every attachment the broker has supplied.
List the documents received so missing schedules are visible immediately.
Done when all supplied broker documents are downloaded and listed.
verify: Compare the document list to the portal attachment count on the request.
Pass when every portal attachment appears on the received document list.

steps.title: Capture insured identity and class data on the workstation indication record
sop: Key the insured legal name, trading address and industry or SIC class into the record.
Confirm the class code is one recognised by the rating manual for the line.
Done when identity and class fields are populated on the indication record.
verify: Read the captured legal name and class code back against the broker submission.
Pass when name, address and class code match the broker documents.

steps.title: Record requested limits, deductibles and coverage basis per section
sop: Enter the requested limit, sub-limit and deductible for each coverage section requested.
Record the coverage basis such as occurrence or claims made for each section.
Done when every requested section carries limit, deductible and basis values.
verify: Count sections requested by the broker against sections captured on the record.
Pass when every requested section has limit, deductible and coverage basis populated.

steps.title: Check exposure basis values for each rated section in the workstation
sop: Confirm TIV, payroll, turnover or fleet count is supplied for each rated section.
Reject placeholder or zero exposure values and mark them as missing.
Done when each rated section has a usable exposure basis value or a recorded gap.
verify: Recount rated sections with a non-zero exposure value against total rated sections.
Pass when every rated section carries an exposure value or an explicit gap note.

steps.title: Assess three years of loss experience against the submission
sop: Check that loss runs covering at least the last three years are supplied.
Where loss experience is unavailable, record that explicitly rather than leaving it blank.
Note any large or open claim that would change the indicative view.
Done when loss experience is either captured for three years or noted as unavailable.
verify: Compare the earliest and latest loss run periods to the required three year window.
Pass when three years are evidenced or an explicit unavailability note is on the record.

steps.title: Record the sufficient or insufficient decision on the indication record
sop: Select sufficient or insufficient on the data sufficiency field of the indication record.
Where insufficient, list the outstanding items so the assistant can chase the broker.
Attach the completed sufficiency checklist to the record.
Done when a sufficiency decision and supporting checklist are saved on the record.
verify: Open the record and confirm the decision field and attached checklist are present.
Confirm any insufficient decision names the outstanding items.
Pass when the decision is recorded with a checklist and named gaps where insufficient.

generic.Defined scope/population: Indication records with a sufficient data decision that require an indicative premium band for the broker.
generic.In-scope period: From the sufficiency decision to the issue of the indicative range to the broker.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Class code, exposure basis, rating run ID, low band, high band and minimum premium test all recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Every indication with a range carries exactly one referenced rating run ID from Earnix.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Earnix rating run output retained with run ID, run timestamp and rate table version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Ranges typed by hand rather than taken from the tool are logged and rebuilt from a fresh rating run.
generic.Test population: Indication records carrying an indicative premium range for the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if no rating run ID is referenced or the low band sits below the filed minimum premium.
generic.Exception handling path: A failed minimum premium test returns to the Underwriter to reset the low band before the range is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An indicative rating run exists, its run ID is on the record and the band width is justified on file.
generic.Evidence location: Earnix rating run output linked from the indication record in the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Open an indicative rating scenario in Earnix Rating & Pricing
sop: Create a new indicative scenario against the account rather than editing an existing run.
Select the product and rate table version applicable to the requested inception date.
Done when an empty indicative scenario exists for the account.
verify: Check the scenario header for product, account and rate table version.
Pass when a new scenario exists with the correct product and rate table version.

steps.title: Key class code and exposure basis into the Earnix indicative scenario
sop: Enter the class or SIC code confirmed during the sufficiency check.
Enter the exposure basis value for each rated section.
Enter policy term and rating state or territory.
Done when all indicative rating inputs are keyed into the scenario.
verify: Read the keyed inputs back against the indication record fields.
Pass when class code, exposure and term in Earnix match the indication record.

steps.title: Execute the indicative rating run in Earnix Rating & Pricing
sop: Run the indicative rating and wait for the run to complete without validation errors.
Capture the low and high band output produced by the tool.
Record the run ID assigned by Earnix.
Done when a completed indicative run with a low and high band and a run ID exists.
verify: Confirm the run completed with no outstanding validation messages.
Pass when a completed run ID exists with a tool-produced low and high band.

steps.title: Test the low band against the filed minimum premium for the line
sop: Look up the filed minimum premium for the class and line in the rating manual.
Compare the low end of the produced band to that minimum premium.
Raise the low band to the minimum premium where the tool output falls below it.
Done when the low band is at or above the filed minimum premium.
verify: Recompute the comparison of low band to filed minimum premium.
Pass when the low band is greater than or equal to the filed minimum premium.

steps.title: Justify the width of the range on the indication file
sop: Assess how much of the band width is driven by missing or uncertain exposure data.
Write a short note naming the uncertainty drivers behind the chosen band width.
Narrow the band where the data quality does not justify a wide spread.
Done when a band width justification note is saved on the indication file.
verify: Read the note and confirm it names specific data uncertainties rather than generic wording.
Pass when the note names the drivers of the band width for this account.

steps.title: Record the rating run ID and band on the workstation indication record
sop: Enter the Earnix run ID into the rating reference field on the indication record.
Enter the low and high band values exactly as produced by the tool.
Attach the rating run output to the record.
Done when run ID, band and run output are all held on the indication record.
verify: Open the referenced run from the record and compare its output to the stored band.
Pass when the stored band equals the referenced Earnix run output.

generic.Defined scope/population: Indication records that have completed appetite review and require a go or no-go decision to the broker.
generic.In-scope period: From completion of appetite review to the outbound go or no-go message to the broker.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Go or no-go flag, reason code on any no-go and further information list on any go all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of indication records with a decision equals count of go or no-go messages issued on the portal.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Decision flag change and the outbound message retained with user, timestamp and message version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Go decisions issued without a prohibited-class check are logged and re-tested before the message stands.
generic.Test population: Indication records carrying a go or no-go decision during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any no-go lacks a controlled reason code or any go was issued on a prohibited class.
generic.Exception handling path: A go on a prohibited class is withdrawn by the Underwriter and reissued as a no-go with a reason code.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Decision flag is set, no-go carries a controlled reason code and go lists the further information required.
generic.Evidence location: Indication record decision fields in the underwriting workstation and the portal outbound message.

steps.title: Review the appetite outcome on the indication record in the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the indication record and read the recorded appetite outcome and its supporting notes.
Confirm class, geography and limit tests were all completed.
Done when the appetite outcome and its supporting tests have been reviewed.
verify: Check that class, geography and limit test results are all present on the record.
Pass when all three appetite tests are recorded before a decision is formed.

steps.title: Screen the insured against the prohibited-class and no-write lists
sop: Open the current prohibited-class and no-write lists held in the workstation.
Screen the insured name and class code against both lists.
Record the screening result and the list version used.
Done when the screening result is recorded on the indication record.
verify: Confirm the screening entry names the list version and the date screened.
Pass when a dated screening result against the current list version is on the record.

steps.title: Set the go or no-go flag on the indication record
sop: Select go or no-go on the indication decision field.
Do not set go where the screening returned a prohibited class hit.
Save the record so the decision is stamped with user and time.
Done when the decision flag is set and saved.
verify: Read the decision flag and the screening result together on the record.
Pass when the flag is set and is consistent with the screening result.

steps.title: Select the appetite or exposure reason code on any no-go
sop: Where the decision is no-go, choose the reason code from the controlled list.
Avoid free-text reasons that will not aggregate in declinature reporting.
Done when every no-go carries a controlled reason code.
verify: Check the reason code field is populated from the controlled list on each no-go.
Pass when no no-go decision is left without a controlled reason code.

steps.title: List the further information required on any go decision
sop: Where the decision is go, list the data needed to firm the indication into a quote.
Name each item specifically such as schedule of values or five year loss runs.
Done when the further information list is recorded on the indication record.
verify: Read the list and confirm each item is a named document or data field.
Pass when every go decision carries a specific further information list.

steps.title: Issue the go or no-go message to the broker through Broker & Agent Portal
sop: Compose the decision message on the portal against the broker account.
State that the indication remains subject to full submission and formal underwriting.
Send the message and capture the portal delivery reference on the indication record.
Done when the decision message is delivered and referenced on the record.
verify: Open the sent message and confirm the subject-to-submission wording is present.
Pass when the delivered message states the decision and the subject-to-submission caveat.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every indication issued with a premium range that rests on assumed coverage terms or unverified data.
generic.In-scope period: From production of the indicative range to the date the indication document is issued.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Assumed limits, sub-limits, deductibles, wording family, key exclusions and underwriter name and date all recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Number of assumed sections in the note equals number of sections priced in the indicative rating run.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assumptions note stored in OpenText with author, version and creation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Indications issued without an assumptions note are logged and the note is added before the file closes.
generic.Test population: Indication records issued during the review period with an attached assumptions note.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the assumptions note is dated after the indication issue date or omits assumed exclusions.
generic.Exception handling path: A missing or late note is escalated to the Underwriter to complete before any quote is prepared.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assumptions note attached to the indication record, dated on or before issue, naming limits, wording and exclusions.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText Document Mgmt assumptions note linked from the workstation indication record.

steps.title: Open the indication record and the indicative rating run in the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the indication record and the referenced rating run side by side.
Identify every section that was priced and the inputs used for each.
Done when the priced sections and their inputs are identified.
verify: Count the priced sections in the rating run against the sections on the record.
Pass when the priced section list matches the indication record sections.

steps.title: List assumed limits, sub-limits and deductibles per section in the assumptions note
sop: Create the assumptions note from the standard template in OpenText Document Mgmt.
Record the assumed limit, sub-limit and deductible used for each priced section.
Mark any value that was assumed rather than supplied by the broker.
Done when every priced section has its assumed structure recorded.
verify: Compare each recorded structure to the corresponding rating run input.
Pass when the note reproduces the rated structure for every priced section.

steps.title: Name the assumed policy wording or form family in the note
sop: State the wording or form family assumed when the indicative price was produced.
Note where a manuscript wording would change the indication materially.
Done when the assumed wording family is named in the note.
verify: Check the named wording family exists in the approved form library.
Pass when the note names a wording family that resolves to an approved form set.

steps.title: State the assumed key exclusions in the note
sop: List the key exclusions assumed such as flood, cyber or communicable disease.
State the pricing consequence if any assumed exclusion is later removed.
Done when the assumed exclusion set is listed with its pricing consequence.
verify: Confirm each assumed exclusion is named individually rather than referenced in bulk.
Pass when the assumed exclusions are individually named in the note.

steps.title: Record explicitly that loss experience is as advised and unverified
sop: Add a statement that loss experience relied on is as advised by the broker and unverified.
Name the loss run source and the period it covers.
Done when the unverified loss experience statement is present in the note.
verify: Read the statement and check it names the loss run source and period.
Pass when the note states the loss data is unverified and names its source.

steps.title: Attach the dated assumptions note to the indication record
sop: Sign the note with the underwriter name and the date it was written.
File the note in OpenText Document Mgmt under the account and indication reference.
Link the filed note to the workstation indication record.
Done when the dated note is attached and reachable from the indication record.
verify: Compare the note date to the indication issue date on the record.
Pass when the attached note is dated on or before the indication issue date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Indication requests requiring an early risk read from prior carrier history and credit or financial stability data.
generic.In-scope period: From the indication request date to the date the risk summary is completed for the indication.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Permissible-purpose code, prior carrier history, credit score, report reference numbers and pull date all recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of report reference numbers on the record equals count of inquiries raised for the account.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Retrieved reports retained with vendor reference, pull date and the requesting user identity.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Adverse signals are logged as referrals with a disposition rather than silently priced into the range.
generic.Test population: Bureau and risk data inquiries raised against indication accounts during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any inquiry was raised without a permissible-purpose code or against a mismatched account reference.
generic.Exception handling path: An inquiry without permissible purpose is reported to compliance and the risk read is redone under a valid purpose.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each inquiry carries a permissible-purpose code and a matching account reference with results on the risk summary.
generic.Evidence location: Report references on the indication record with the retrieved reports filed against the account.

steps.title: Select the permissible-purpose code before ordering any report
sop: Determine the lawful purpose for the inquiry such as insurance underwriting.
Select that permissible-purpose code in Credit Bureau & Data Services before ordering.
Do not proceed where no valid purpose applies to the account.
Done when a permissible-purpose code is selected against the order.
verify: Read the purpose code stored on the order screen before submission.
Pass when a valid permissible-purpose code is attached to the order.

steps.title: Order the prior carrier history report in LexisNexis Risk
sop: Search LexisNexis Risk on the insured legal name and trading address.
Order the prior carrier history covering policy periods, lapses and cancellations.
Capture the vendor reference number returned for the order.
Done when the prior carrier report is returned with a reference number.
verify: Confirm the returned report matches the insured legal name and address searched.
Pass when the report resolves to the correct insured with a vendor reference.

steps.title: Read the prior carrier history for lapses and cancellations
sop: Review the report for coverage lapses, mid-term cancellations and non-renewals.
Note the reason given for any cancellation where the report states it.
Summarise the coverage continuity picture on the risk summary.
Done when lapse and cancellation findings are summarised on the risk summary.
verify: Check the summary names each lapse or cancellation found in the report.
Pass when every lapse or cancellation in the report appears on the risk summary.

steps.title: Capture the credit or financial stability score in Credit Bureau & Data Services
sop: Order the commercial credit or financial stability report under the selected purpose.
Record the returned score and score date on the risk summary.
Capture the vendor reference for the credit inquiry.
Done when the credit score and its reference are on the risk summary.
verify: Compare the recorded score and date to the returned report.
Pass when the recorded score and date match the vendor report.

steps.title: Flag adverse signals for referral rather than pricing them in
sop: Identify adverse signals such as repeated cancellations or a deteriorating credit score.
Raise a referral on the indication record for each adverse signal found.
Do not absorb an adverse signal into the indicative range without a referral.
Done when every adverse signal has an open referral on the record.
verify: Count adverse signals identified against referrals raised on the record.
Pass when every identified adverse signal has a matching referral entry.

steps.title: Record report references and pull date on the indication record
sop: Enter every vendor reference number and the pull date onto the indication record.
Attach the retrieved reports to the account file.
Done when references, pull date and reports are held on the indication record.
verify: Resolve each stored reference back to its retrieved report.
Pass when every stored reference resolves to an attached report for the account.

generic.Defined scope/population: All inbound broker requests for budget or ballpark pricing received ahead of a formal submission.
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of the broker request to the acknowledgement sent within the service standard.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Broker name, branch, producer code, requested inception date, target premium and request type all captured.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of inbound indication requests in the portal equals count of indication request records created in CRM.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Inbound request and acknowledgement retained with receipt and send timestamps on the CRM record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requests that cannot be linked to an account are logged and dispositioned by creating a new account record.
generic.Test population: Indication request records created in CRM during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any request lacks a producer code or is not acknowledged within the stated service standard.
generic.Exception handling path: Requests missing broker identifiers are returned to the broker for completion before an indication is worked.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Indication request record created with broker, producer code, requested inception date and request type Indication.
generic.Evidence location: CRM indication request record linked to the Broker & Agent Portal inbound request.

steps.title: Open the inbound request in Broker & Agent Portal
sop: Open the new inbound request in the portal queue.
Read the request to confirm it seeks an indication and not a formal quote.
Done when the inbound request is opened and its nature confirmed.
verify: Check the request wording for indication or budget pricing language.
Pass when the request is confirmed as an indication request.

steps.title: Capture broker name, branch and producer code on the CRM request record
sop: Create the indication request record in CRM (Salesforce/Dynamics).
Key the broker name, branch and producer code from the portal request.
Done when broker identifiers are populated on the CRM request record.
verify: Match the captured producer code to the broker record held in CRM.
Pass when the producer code resolves to an active broker in CRM.

steps.title: Record the requested inception date and any target premium
sop: Enter the requested inception or effective date stated by the broker.
Record any target premium or budget figure the broker has given.
Note if no target has been supplied rather than leaving the field empty.
Done when inception date and target premium position are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded inception date to the date stated in the portal request.
Pass when the recorded inception date matches the broker request.

steps.title: Mark the request type as Indication on the CRM record
sop: Set the request type field to Indication rather than Full submission.
Confirm the workflow routes to the indication queue and not the submission queue.
Done when the request type is Indication and routed to the indication queue.
verify: Read the request type field and the queue the record now sits in.
Pass when type is Indication and the record sits in the indication queue.

steps.title: Link the request to an existing account or create a new account record
sop: Search CRM for an existing account matching the insured legal name.
Link the request to that account where a match exists.
Create a new account record where no match is found and link the request to it.
Done when the request is linked to exactly one account record.
verify: Confirm the linked account name matches the insured named in the request.
Pass when the request resolves to a single account matching the insured.

steps.title: Send the acknowledgement to the broker within the service standard
sop: Send the standard acknowledgement to the broker through Broker & Agent Portal.
State who is handling the request and the expected response time.
Log the acknowledgement against the CRM request record.
Done when the acknowledgement is sent and logged.
verify: Compare the acknowledgement send time to the request receipt time.
Pass when the elapsed time is within the stated acknowledgement service standard.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every indication communicated to a broker that must be represented by a workflow record.
generic.In-scope period: From issue of the indication to the indication validity expiry held on the record.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Broker account link, premium range, validity date, underwriter of record and owning desk all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of indications issued to brokers equals count of records at status Indication issued.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Indication record version history and the attached issued document with its creation timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Indications issued without a workflow record are logged and back-recorded with the actual issue date.
generic.Test population: Workflow indication records created in the workstation during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any record at Indication issued has no attached issued document or no owning underwriter.
generic.Exception handling path: Records missing a document or owner are returned to the Underwriting Assistant for completion before month end.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Record exists at status Indication issued, linked to the broker account, with the issued document attached.
generic.Evidence location: Indication record in the underwriting workstation with the linked policy administration system submission.

steps.title: Create the indication record in the underwriting workstation
sop: Create a new indication record against the insured account.
Set the line of business and requested inception date on the record.
Done when the indication record exists for the correct insured and line.
verify: Check the record insured name and line against the broker request.
Pass when the new record carries the correct insured and line of business.

steps.title: Link the indication record to the broker account
sop: Attach the broker and producer code to the indication record.
Confirm the linked broker matches the requesting broker on the portal request.
Done when the broker account link is saved on the record.
verify: Open the linked broker record and compare it to the request producer code.
Pass when the linked broker matches the requesting producer code.

steps.title: Key the premium range and validity date into the record
sop: Enter the indicative low and high premium exactly as issued to the broker.
Enter the validity or expiry date stated in the indication document.
Done when range and validity date are stored on the record.
verify: Compare the stored range and date to the issued indication document.
Pass when stored range and validity date match the issued document.

steps.title: Assign the underwriter of record and owning desk
sop: Assign the underwriter of record by name on the indication record.
Set the owning desk so the record appears on the correct work queue.
Done when underwriter of record and owning desk are both set.
verify: Confirm the assigned underwriter has authority for the line and the record queue is correct.
Pass when a named underwriter with authority for the line owns the record.

steps.title: Attach the issued indication document to the record
sop: Upload the document actually sent to the broker, not a working draft.
Version the attachment so later revisions do not overwrite it.
Done when the issued document is attached and versioned.
verify: Open the attachment and compare it to the portal sent message.
Pass when the attached document matches the document sent to the broker.

steps.title: Advance the workflow status to Indication issued and mirror it to the policy administration system
sop: Set the workflow status to Indication issued on the workstation record.
Confirm the linked submission in the policy administration system reflects the same stage.
Done when both systems show the indication as issued.
verify: Read the status in the workstation and in the policy administration system.
Pass when both systems show the indication at issued stage.

generic.Defined scope/population: Indication requests with sufficient data that require an appetite and market rate level review.
generic.In-scope period: From the data sufficiency decision to the recorded appetite outcome on the indication record.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Class code, catastrophe zone, requested limit, screening result and appetite outcome all recorded on the record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of indications with an appetite outcome equals count of indications that passed data sufficiency.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Appetite review entry retained with reviewer name, review date and the target-class list version used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Risks outside appetite are logged as referral or decline with the specific breaching test named.
generic.Test population: Indication records with a recorded appetite outcome during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an appetite outcome is recorded without the class code and requested limit that were tested.
generic.Exception handling path: Outcomes recorded as referral route to the Senior Underwriter before any indication is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Appetite outcome recorded together with the class code, geography, limit tested and the screening result.
generic.Evidence location: Appetite review entry on the indication record in the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Check the class code against the target-class list in the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the current target-class list for the line in the workstation.
Test the insured class or SIC code against that list.
Record whether the class is target, non-target or excluded.
Done when the class test result is recorded on the indication record.
verify: Confirm the recorded result names the class code and the list version used.
Pass when the class test result names both the class code and list version.

steps.title: Test geography and catastrophe zone against appetite limits
sop: Identify the locations and their catastrophe exposure zones.
Compare zone accumulation against the appetite limits for the line.
Record any zone that is at or above the appetite threshold.
Done when the geography and catastrophe test result is recorded.
verify: Check each location zone appears in the recorded test result.
Pass when every location zone has been tested and recorded.

steps.title: Compare the requested limit to the maximum written line for the class
sop: Look up the maximum written line for the class in the workstation authority tables.
Compare the largest requested limit to that maximum.
Flag the excess amount where the requested limit is larger.
Done when the limit test result and any excess are recorded.
verify: Recompute requested limit minus maximum written line for the class.
Pass when the recorded result matches the recomputed comparison.

steps.title: Screen the insured against the no-write and prohibited-risk lists
sop: Screen the insured legal name and class against the no-write and prohibited-risk lists.
Record the screening result and list version on the indication record.
Done when the screening result is stored on the record.
verify: Confirm the screening entry is dated and names the list version.
Pass when a dated screening result against the current lists is present.

steps.title: Compare indicated rate level to current market levels in Earnix Rating & Pricing
sop: Open the class benchmark rate view in Earnix Rating & Pricing.
Compare the expected rate per unit of exposure to the current benchmark for the class.
Note whether the risk is likely to be priced competitively at technical rate.
Done when the rate level comparison is noted on the indication record.
verify: Check the note states the benchmark used and the comparison outcome.
Pass when the note names the benchmark and the resulting rate level view.

steps.title: Record the appetite outcome on the indication record
sop: Select in, out or referral on the appetite outcome field.
Where the outcome is out or referral, name the specific test that drove it.
Save the outcome with reviewer name and date.
Done when the appetite outcome and its driver are recorded.
verify: Read the outcome, the named driving test and the reviewer stamp.
Pass when the outcome is recorded with a named driving test and reviewer.

generic.Defined scope/population: All live indications awaiting a formal submission from the broker before their validity expires.
generic.In-scope period: From the indication issue date to the indication expiry date carried on the record.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Diary due date, named task owner, chase description and indication expiry date all populated on the task.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of live indications equals count of open follow-up tasks on the workstation diary.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Diary task retained with creation timestamp, owner and the cadence dates originally set.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Indications found without a follow-up task are logged and a task is raised the same day.
generic.Test population: Follow-up tasks open against live indications during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any follow-up task is due after the indication expiry date or has no named owner.
generic.Exception handling path: Tasks due after expiry are re-dated by the Underwriting Assistant and re-checked by the Underwriter.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An open follow-up task exists dated before indication expiry with a named owner and a stated chase target.
generic.Evidence location: Diary task on the underwriting workstation indication record mirrored to the CRM opportunity.

steps.title: Read the indication expiry date from the workstation indication record
sop: Open the indication record and read the stored expiry date.
Confirm the expiry date matches the date issued to the broker.
Done when the confirmed expiry date is known.
verify: Compare the record expiry date to the issued indication document.
Pass when the record expiry date equals the date in the issued document.

steps.title: Create the follow-up diary task on the indication record
sop: Create a diary task against the indication record in the workstation.
Set the due date ahead of the indication expiry date.
Done when an open diary task exists with a due date before expiry.
verify: Compare the task due date to the indication expiry date.
Pass when the task due date falls before the indication expiry date.

steps.title: Assign the task to the underwriter or assistant by name
sop: Assign the diary task to a named individual rather than a shared queue.
Confirm the assignee is active and holds the account.
Done when the task carries a named active owner.
verify: Read the task owner field and confirm the user is active.
Pass when the task owner is a named active user on the account.

steps.title: Describe the chase target in the task description
sop: State that the item being chased is the full submission pack.
List the specific documents outstanding from the go decision.
Done when the task description names the submission pack and its outstanding items.
verify: Read the description for the named submission items.
Pass when the description names the specific outstanding submission items.

steps.title: Set the chase cadence rather than a single reminder
sop: Create the second and any subsequent chase dates such as day 7 and day 21.
Ensure the final chase date still precedes the indication expiry.
Done when multiple dated chase points exist before expiry.
verify: Count the chase points created and compare the last one to the expiry date.
Pass when at least two chase points exist and all precede expiry.

steps.title: Mirror the indication expiry onto the CRM opportunity
sop: Open the CRM (Salesforce/Dynamics) opportunity linked to the indication.
Record the indication expiry date and the follow-up owner on the opportunity.
Done when the expiry date and owner appear on the CRM opportunity.
verify: Compare the CRM expiry date to the workstation indication record.
Pass when the CRM expiry date matches the workstation record.

generic.Defined scope/population: Live indications where the broker has supplied refined exposure data or a revised coverage structure.
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of the refined broker data to issue of the replacement indication.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: New rating run ID, revised range, revision reason, new validity date and superseded flag all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of indication versions equals count of rating runs referenced on the indication record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each indication version retained with its own rating run output, author and issue timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Revisions issued without withdrawing the prior range are logged and a withdrawal message is sent.
generic.Test population: Indication records carrying more than one version during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a revised range exists without a recorded revision reason or without a fresh rating run.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing revision reasons return to the Underwriter to complete before the revised range is relied on.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: At least two indication versions exist, each with a rating run and a recorded revision reason.
generic.Evidence location: Indication version history in the underwriting workstation with linked Earnix rating runs.

steps.title: Key the refined exposure or coverage data into Earnix Rating & Pricing
sop: Copy the refined exposure values or revised coverage structure from the broker update.
Create a new Earnix scenario rather than overwriting the original indicative run.
Key the refined values into the new scenario.
Done when a new scenario holds the refined data.
verify: Compare the keyed values to the broker update document.
Pass when the new scenario inputs match the refined broker data.

steps.title: Execute a fresh indicative rating run in Earnix Rating & Pricing
sop: Run the refreshed indicative scenario to completion.
Take the new low and high band from the tool output.
Capture the new run ID.
Done when a completed run produces a revised band with a run ID.
verify: Confirm the run completed and returned a band and run ID.
Pass when a new run ID with a produced band exists for the refined data.

steps.title: Issue the revised range as a new indication version in the workstation
sop: Create a new version of the indication record rather than editing the existing one.
Store the revised band and the new run ID on the new version.
Retain the prior version unchanged for audit.
Done when a new indication version exists alongside the retained original.
verify: List the indication versions and confirm the original is intact.
Pass when both versions exist with their own band and run ID.

steps.title: Note the movement versus the original range and its driver
sop: Calculate the change between the original and revised bands.
Name the driver such as increased TIV or a revised deductible structure.
Record the movement and driver on the new version.
Done when movement and driver are recorded on the new version.
verify: Recompute the movement from the two stored bands.
Pass when the recorded movement matches the recomputed difference.

steps.title: Set a new validity and expiry date on the updated indication
sop: Enter the new validity period on the revised indication version.
Confirm the derived expiry date runs from the revision issue date.
Done when the revised version carries its own validity and expiry date.
verify: Compare the expiry date to the revision issue date plus validity period.
Pass when the expiry date equals revision issue date plus validity period.

steps.title: Tell the broker in writing that the earlier indication is withdrawn
sop: Send the revised indication with a statement that the earlier range is withdrawn.
Mark the prior version as superseded on the workstation record.
Done when the withdrawal is sent and the prior version is marked superseded.
verify: Read the outbound message for the withdrawal statement and check the prior version status.
Pass when the message withdraws the earlier range and the prior version reads superseded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Quotes where filed schedule rating credits or debits are being applied to the technical rate.
generic.In-scope period: From finalisation of rating inputs to the locking of the modified rate for the quote.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each modifier value, its named rating characteristic, its justification and the net modification all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of applied credits and debits equals the net schedule modification shown on the rating worksheet.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rating worksheet retained with modifier values, justifications, user and run timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Modifiers outside the filed range are logged and either reduced or routed to referral before rate lock.
generic.Test population: Quotes with one or more schedule modifiers applied during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any applied credit or debit has an empty justification or the net falls outside the filed range.
generic.Exception handling path: Out-of-range or unjustified modifiers block rate lock and route to the Senior Underwriter for decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every credit or debit carries a written justification and the net modification sits within the filed range.
generic.Evidence location: Earnix rating worksheet linked to the Guidewire PolicyCenter quote record.

steps.title: Open the rating worksheet for the quote in Earnix Rating & Pricing
sop: Open the finalised rating scenario for the quote in Earnix.
Confirm the base technical premium before modification is displayed.
Done when the worksheet is open showing the unmodified technical premium.
verify: Check the displayed base premium against the locked rating inputs.
Pass when the base premium reflects the locked rating input set.

steps.title: Enter each credit or debit against its named rating characteristic
sop: Enter modifiers individually against management, premises, loss control and other named characteristics.
Do not aggregate several judgements into a single unnamed modifier.
Done when every modifier sits against a named rating characteristic.
verify: List the applied modifiers and confirm each names a characteristic.
Pass when no modifier is recorded without a named rating characteristic.

steps.title: Enter a written justification for each modifier
sop: Write a specific justification against each modifier citing the risk feature relied on.
Avoid one blanket comment covering multiple modifiers.
Done when every modifier carries its own justification text.
verify: Count modifiers with non-empty justification against total modifiers applied.
Pass when every applied modifier has a non-empty individual justification.

steps.title: Test the net schedule modification against the filed range
sop: Read the net credit or debit percentage produced by the worksheet.
Compare it to the filed maximum credit and debit range for the line.
Reduce the modifiers where the net breaches the filed range.
Done when the net modification sits within the filed range.
verify: Recompute the net from the individual modifiers and compare to the filed range.
Pass when the recomputed net falls inside the filed credit and debit range.

steps.title: Route any modification beyond authority to referral before rate lock
sop: Test the net modification against the underwriter schedule rating authority.
Raise a referral where the modification exceeds that authority.
Hold the rate unlocked until the referral is decided.
Done when any beyond-authority modification carries a decided referral.
verify: Check for an open referral against any modification above authority.
Pass when no beyond-authority modification remains without a decided referral.

steps.title: Re-run the modified rate and capture the indicated premium in Guidewire PolicyCenter
sop: Re-run the rating with the approved modifiers applied.
Push the modified indicated premium through to the Guidewire PolicyCenter quote.
Record the run ID that produced the modified premium.
Done when the quote in PolicyCenter shows the modified premium and its run ID.
verify: Compare the premium on the PolicyCenter quote to the referenced Earnix run output.
Pass when the quote premium equals the referenced modified run output.

generic.Defined scope/population: Quotes that have cleared pricing and require a broker-ready quote document to be assembled.
generic.In-scope period: From rate lock on the quote to generation of the quote document for release.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Coverage summary, subjectivity schedule, form schedule, premium breakdown and expiry date all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Section premiums plus taxes and fees on the document equal the total quoted premium on the quote record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Generated quote PDF filed in OpenText with version number and generation timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Documents generated without a subjectivity schedule are logged and regenerated before release.
generic.Test population: Quote documents generated during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the generated PDF omits the subjectivity schedule, the form schedule or the expiry date.
generic.Exception handling path: Incomplete quote documents return to the Underwriting Assistant for regeneration before any release.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Quote PDF filed containing coverage summary, subjectivity schedule, form schedule and premium breakdown.
generic.Evidence location: Quote PDF in OpenText Document Mgmt linked from the policy administration system quote record.

steps.title: Open the priced quote in the policy administration system
sop: Open the quote in the policy administration system at rate-locked stage.
Confirm the pricing is final and no rating change is pending.
Done when the rate-locked quote is open for document assembly.
verify: Check the quote stage and that no pending rating transaction exists.
Pass when the quote is rate-locked with no pending rating change.

steps.title: Build the coverage summary with limits, sub-limits and deductibles
sop: List every quoted section on the coverage summary page.
Show the limit, sub-limit and deductible against each section.
Done when every quoted section appears with its full structure.
verify: Count sections on the summary against sections priced on the quote record.
Pass when every priced section appears with limit, sub-limit and deductible.

steps.title: Set out the subjectivities as a numbered schedule with due dates
sop: List each subjectivity as a numbered item with a specific due date.
State what evidence satisfies each subjectivity.
Done when every subjectivity is numbered with a due date and evidence description.
verify: Check each numbered subjectivity carries a due date.
Pass when no subjectivity is listed without a due date.

steps.title: Attach the endorsement and form schedule with edition dates
sop: Generate the form schedule listing every form number and edition date.
Attach the endorsement schedule to the document pack.
Done when the document carries a complete form and endorsement schedule.
verify: Compare the form list to the forms attached on the quote record.
Pass when every form on the quote record appears on the schedule with an edition date.

steps.title: Break the premium down by section with taxes and fees shown separately
sop: Show the premium for each section, then taxes and fees on separate lines.
Show the total payable including taxes and fees.
Done when the document shows the section breakdown and the total payable.
verify: Sum the section premiums plus taxes and fees and compare to the shown total.
Pass when the summed components equal the total payable on the document.

steps.title: Print the quote expiry date and underwriter contact and file the PDF
sop: Print the quote expiry date and the named underwriter contact on the front page.
Generate the final PDF from the policy administration system.
File the PDF in OpenText Document Mgmt against the quote reference.
Done when the filed PDF shows the expiry date and named contact.
verify: Open the filed PDF and check the front page for expiry date and contact.
Pass when the filed PDF front page carries the expiry date and named underwriter.

generic.Defined scope/population: All quote packages awaiting release that carry exposure in one or more regulated jurisdictions.
generic.In-scope period: From quote document assembly to the setting of the release flag on the quote record.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: State notices, surplus lines disclosure, TRIA offer, fraud warning and the disclosure sign-off all present.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of states of exposure equals count of jurisdictions with mandated notices attached.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Disclosure checklist retained with sign-off user, date and the notice form editions attached.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing jurisdiction notices are logged and attached before the quote release flag can be set.
generic.Test population: Quote packages released during the review period with multi-state exposure.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any state of exposure lacks its mandated notices or the TRIA offer wording is absent.
generic.Exception handling path: A missing notice blocks release and returns to the Underwriter to attach before the quote is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: All jurisdiction-mandated notices attached for each state of exposure with a signed disclosure checklist.
generic.Evidence location: Disclosure checklist on the policy administration system quote record with notices filed in OpenText.

steps.title: List the states of exposure from the quote in the policy administration system
sop: Extract every state or jurisdiction with a rated location or operation on the quote.
Include the state of the named insured domicile.
Done when the full list of exposure jurisdictions is recorded.
verify: Compare the list to the rated locations on the quote record.
Pass when every rated location jurisdiction appears on the list.

steps.title: Attach the mandated notices for each state of exposure
sop: Look up the mandated notices for each listed jurisdiction in the form library.
Attach the current edition of each mandated notice to the quote pack.
Done when each jurisdiction has its mandated notices attached.
verify: Tick off each jurisdiction against its attached notices.
Pass when no jurisdiction on the list is left without its mandated notices.

steps.title: Include surplus lines and diligent-search wording where non-admitted
sop: Determine whether the placement is admitted or non-admitted in each jurisdiction.
Attach the surplus lines disclosure and diligent-search wording for non-admitted placements.
Done when non-admitted jurisdictions carry the surplus lines wording.
verify: Check the admitted status flag against the attached surplus lines wording.
Pass when every non-admitted jurisdiction carries its surplus lines disclosure.

steps.title: Confirm the TRIA offer and rejection wording with the terrorism premium shown
sop: Confirm the terrorism offer and rejection wording appears in the quote pack.
Confirm the terrorism premium is shown as a separate figure.
Done when the TRIA offer wording and terrorism premium are both present.
verify: Read the TRIA wording and locate the separately shown terrorism premium.
Pass when the offer wording and a stated terrorism premium are both present.

steps.title: Include the applicable state fraud warning notice
sop: Select the fraud warning notice applicable to each jurisdiction.
Attach the notice to the quote pack in OpenText Document Mgmt.
Done when the correct fraud warning is attached for each jurisdiction.
verify: Compare the attached fraud warning text to the jurisdiction requirement.
Pass when each jurisdiction carries its correct fraud warning notice.

steps.title: Sign off the disclosure checklist on the quote record before release
sop: Complete the disclosure checklist item by item on the quote record.
Sign off the checklist with name and date.
Do not set the release flag while any checklist item is open.
Done when the checklist is fully signed off with no open items.
verify: Check for open items on the checklist and read the sign-off stamp.
Pass when the checklist is signed and no item remains open.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every form and endorsement selected onto a quote before that quote is released to the broker.
generic.In-scope period: From form selection on the quote to the pre-release quality check on the same quote version.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Form number, edition date, jurisdiction eligibility and any manuscript approval reference all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of forms on the schedule equals count of forms matched to a current filed edition.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Form schedule retained with edition dates, checker name and the library version consulted.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Superseded or unfiled editions are logged and replaced with the current filed edition before release.
generic.Test population: Form schedules attached to quotes released during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any form on the schedule carries a superseded edition date or has no filing evidence.
generic.Exception handling path: Unfiled or manuscript wording without an approval reference routes to the Senior Underwriter before release.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No form on the schedule carries a superseded or unfiled edition and each is eligible in its jurisdiction.
generic.Evidence location: Form schedule on the policy administration system quote record with library evidence filed in OpenText.

steps.title: Export the form schedule from the policy administration system quote
sop: Export the full list of forms and endorsements attached to the quote.
Include form number, edition date and the section each applies to.
Done when the complete form schedule is exported for checking.
verify: Compare the exported count to the forms shown on the quote record.
Pass when the export contains every form attached to the quote.

steps.title: Match each form number to the current filed edition in the form library
sop: Look up each form number in the approved and filed form library.
Compare the edition date on the quote to the current filed edition.
Mark any mismatch for replacement.
Done when every form has been matched against the library.
verify: Count forms matched to a current filed edition against total forms.
Pass when every form on the schedule matches a current filed edition.

steps.title: Replace superseded editions carried over from the expiring policy
sop: Identify forms copied from the expiring policy that now carry an old edition.
Replace each with the current filed edition on the quote.
Re-check that replacement did not change the intended coverage grant.
Done when no superseded edition remains on the quote.
verify: Re-export the schedule and re-check edition dates against the library.
Pass when the re-exported schedule shows no superseded edition dates.

steps.title: Flag manuscript or non-filed wording with its approval reference
sop: Identify any manuscript or non-filed wording attached to the quote.
Record the approval reference authorising its use.
Remove any manuscript wording that has no approval reference.
Done when every manuscript wording carries an approval reference.
verify: Check each manuscript wording for a recorded approval reference.
Pass when no manuscript wording remains without an approval reference.

steps.title: Check form eligibility per jurisdiction for each state of exposure
sop: For each state of exposure, confirm each form is eligible for use in that state.
Substitute the state-specific variant where one exists.
Done when every form is eligible in every state where it applies.
verify: Test a sample of forms against the jurisdiction eligibility table.
Pass when no form is attached in a jurisdiction where it is ineligible.

steps.title: Check the exclusion set for conflict with the coverage grant
sop: Read the attached exclusions against the coverage grant being quoted.
Identify any exclusion that removes the cover the quote is intended to provide.
Resolve the conflict by removing or amending the offending form.
Done when no exclusion contradicts the intended coverage grant.
verify: Re-read the final exclusion set against the coverage summary.
Pass when no attached exclusion negates a quoted coverage grant.

generic.Defined scope/population: All submissions accepted for quoting that require a locked rating input set before pricing.
generic.In-scope period: From acceptance of the submission to the stamping of the rating version on the quote record.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Exposure values, class codes, policy term, inception date, rating state and loss experience all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Total TIV keyed into the rating engine equals the total on the broker schedule of values.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Locked input set retained with rating version, lock timestamp and the locking user identity.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Exposure variances against the schedule of values are logged and either corrected or explained on the file.
generic.Test population: Quotes with a locked rating input set created during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the locked inputs carry no rating version stamp or exposure differs from the schedule of values.
generic.Exception handling path: Unreconciled exposure returns to the Underwriting Assistant to re-key from the schedule before lock.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Input set locked with rating version and effective date recorded and exposure reconciled to the schedule.
generic.Evidence location: Locked rating scenario in Earnix Rating & Pricing linked to the Guidewire PolicyCenter quote.

steps.title: Load the broker schedule of values into the Guidewire PolicyCenter submission
sop: Import or key the broker schedule of values into the submission location schedule.
Check each location has an address, construction and occupancy where required.
Done when every scheduled location is present on the submission.
verify: Compare the location count on the submission to the broker schedule.
Pass when the submission location count equals the broker schedule count.

steps.title: Reconcile exposure values to the broker schedule of values
sop: Total the TIV, payroll, turnover or unit counts held on the submission.
Compare each total to the corresponding total on the broker schedule.
Investigate and resolve any variance before proceeding.
Done when exposure totals agree with the broker schedule.
verify: Recompute the exposure totals from the submission and compare to the schedule totals.
Pass when recomputed totals equal the broker schedule totals.

steps.title: Confirm class and SIC codes against the rating manual for each location
sop: Check the class or SIC code held for each location against the rating manual.
Correct any code that does not describe the actual operation at that location.
Done when every location carries a valid manual class code.
verify: Test each location class code for existence in the rating manual.
Pass when every location class code resolves in the rating manual.

steps.title: Set policy term, inception date and rating state on the submission
sop: Enter the policy term and requested inception date from the submission.
Set the rating state or territory consistent with the exposure.
Done when term, inception and rating state are all set.
verify: Compare the term and inception to the broker submission document.
Pass when term, inception and rating state match the submission document.

steps.title: Enter loss experience and any experience modifier in Earnix Rating & Pricing
sop: Key the loss experience from the supplied loss runs into the rating scenario.
Apply any experience modifier calculated under the filed rating plan.
Record the loss run period the experience covers.
Done when loss experience and any modifier are entered with their period.
verify: Compare entered incurred losses to the totals on the supplied loss runs.
Pass when entered incurred losses equal the loss run totals for the stated period.

steps.title: Lock the rating inputs and stamp the rating version on the quote record
sop: Lock the input set in Earnix so later edits create a new version.
Stamp the rating version and effective date onto the Guidewire PolicyCenter quote record.
Done when the inputs are locked and the version is stamped on the quote.
verify: Attempt an input edit and confirm it forces a new version rather than changing the locked set.
Pass when the locked set is immutable and its version appears on the quote record.

generic.Defined scope/population: Quotes meeting the peer review trigger on premium size, limit or class complexity for the line.
generic.In-scope period: From completion of pricing to the setting of the quote release flag.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Trigger test result, named second underwriter, reviewer comments, review status and approval date all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of quotes meeting the trigger equals count of quotes carrying a completed peer review entry.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Peer review entry retained with reviewer name, comments and approval timestamp against the quote version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Quotes released without a required peer review are logged and reviewed retrospectively with the outcome recorded.
generic.Test population: Quotes released during the review period that met the peer review trigger.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the reviewer is the same person as the quoting underwriter or no approval date is recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: Reviewer-required changes block release until actioned and re-checked by the Senior Underwriter.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Peer review entry names a reviewer different from the quoting underwriter with an approval date.
generic.Evidence location: Peer review entry on the underwriting workstation quote record linked to the policy administration system quote.

steps.title: Test the peer review trigger on the workstation quote record
sop: Compare quoted premium, largest limit and class complexity to the peer review thresholds.
Record whether the quote is in or out of scope for peer review.
Done when the trigger test result is recorded on the quote record.
verify: Recompute the trigger test from the quoted premium and limit.
Pass when the recorded trigger result matches the recomputed test.

steps.title: Assign a named second underwriter in the review field
sop: Assign a reviewer who did not price the quote.
Confirm the reviewer holds authority appropriate to the quote size.
Done when a qualified second underwriter is named on the review field.
verify: Compare the reviewer name to the quoting underwriter name.
Pass when the reviewer differs from the quoting underwriter and holds sufficient authority.

steps.title: Review pricing adequacy against the technical premium
sop: Compare the quoted premium to the technical premium and the class benchmark.
Assess whether the modifiers and loadings applied are supportable.
Record a written comment on pricing adequacy.
Done when a written pricing adequacy comment is on the review entry.
verify: Read the comment and confirm it names the technical premium comparison.
Pass when the comment quantifies the position against technical premium.

steps.title: Review terms and subjectivities on the policy administration system quote
sop: Read the coverage structure, form schedule and subjectivity list on the quote.
Record comments on any term or subjectivity that needs to change.
Done when written comments on terms and subjectivities are recorded.
verify: Confirm the review entry addresses both terms and subjectivities.
Pass when the review entry contains comments on terms and on subjectivities.

steps.title: Action and re-check any reviewer-required change before release
sop: Make each change the reviewer required on the quote.
Return the amended quote to the reviewer for re-check.
Done when every reviewer-required change is actioned and re-checked.
verify: Count reviewer-required changes against changes actioned and re-checked.
Pass when no reviewer-required change remains open on the quote.

steps.title: Set the review status to Approved with reviewer name and date
sop: Set the peer review status to Approved on the quote record.
Confirm reviewer name and approval date are stamped.
Done when the quote carries an approved peer review with name and date.
verify: Read the review status, reviewer name and approval date on the record.
Pass when status is Approved with a named reviewer and an approval date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every quote awaiting release that must pass the pre-release accuracy and authority check.
generic.In-scope period: From quote document assembly to the setting of the release flag on the quote record.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Insured details, limits, deductibles, premium, subjectivity owners and authority evidence all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Premium printed on the quote document equals the rating engine output including taxes and fees.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Completed pre-release checklist retained with checker name, date and the quote version checked.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed checklist items are logged and dispositioned as corrected before release or as blocked.
generic.Test population: Quotes released during the review period with a completed pre-release checklist.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any checklist item is left failed or open when the release flag is set.
generic.Exception handling path: Open or failed items block release and return to the Underwriter for correction and re-check.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Checklist fully completed with no open failed items and authority evidence present on the file.
generic.Evidence location: Pre-release checklist on the underwriting workstation quote record.

steps.title: Match insured name, address and policy period to the submission
sop: Compare the insured legal name and address on the quote to the broker submission.
Compare the policy period on the quote to the requested period.
