Correct any mismatch in the policy administration system before continuing.
Done when insured details and policy period match the submission.
verify: Read the quote header against the submission document field by field.
Pass when name, address and policy period agree with the submission.

steps.title: Match limits, sub-limits and deductibles to the rating worksheet
sop: Compare each limit, sub-limit and deductible on the quote to the rating worksheet.
Investigate any figure that differs from the rated structure.
Done when the quoted structure matches the rated structure for every section.
verify: Tick each section structure on the quote against the worksheet.
Pass when no section shows a difference between quote and worksheet.

steps.title: Reconcile the document premium to the rating engine output
sop: Compare the premium printed on the quote to the rating engine output.
Include taxes and fees in the comparison.
Regenerate the document where a difference is found.
Done when the printed premium equals the rating output including taxes and fees.
verify: Recompute the total from the rating output plus taxes and fees.
Pass when the recomputed total equals the premium printed on the quote.

steps.title: Check the subjectivity list carries an owner and due date per item
sop: Read each subjectivity and confirm it names an owner and a due date.
Add the owner or due date where either is missing.
Done when every subjectivity has an owner and a due date.
verify: Count subjectivities with both owner and due date against total subjectivities.
Pass when every subjectivity carries an owner and a due date.

steps.title: Confirm authority and peer review evidence is on the file
sop: Confirm the authority check result is recorded on the quote record.
Confirm any required peer review is approved and dated.
Do not proceed while either piece of evidence is missing.
Done when both authority and peer review evidence are present.
verify: Open the authority check entry and the peer review entry on the record.
Pass when both entries exist with recorded outcomes and dates.

steps.title: Complete the checklist and set the release flag on the quote record
sop: Mark each checklist item pass or fail in the workstation.
Correct any failed item and re-check it before completing.
Set the release flag only once no item is failed or open.
Done when the checklist is complete and the release flag is set.
verify: List any failed or open checklist items on the record.
Pass when no failed or open item exists at the moment the release flag is set.

generic.Defined scope/population: Quotes being populated from an approved rating model run rather than from manual pricing.
generic.In-scope period: From completion of the model run to the pre-release quality check on the same quote version.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Technical premium, loadings, final premium, per-section allocation, commission and model run ID all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of per-section premiums on the quote equals the total model output premium for the account.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Model run output retained with run ID, model version and run timestamp against the quote version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Overrides of the model price are logged with reason and deviation size and dispositioned by approval.
generic.Test population: Quotes populated from a rating model run during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the quoted premium differs from the referenced model run with no recorded override reason.
generic.Exception handling path: Unexplained differences return to the Underwriter to re-populate from the model or record an override.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Quoted premium equals the referenced model run output or carries a recorded override reason and size.
generic.Evidence location: Model run reference on the policy administration system quote record linked to the Earnix run output.

steps.title: Open the approved model run output in Earnix Rating & Pricing
sop: Open the model run that was approved for this quote.
Confirm the run is the latest approved run and not a superseded scenario.
Done when the approved model run output is open.
verify: Check the run status and compare its run ID to the quote record reference.
Pass when the open run is approved and matches the quote reference.

steps.title: Record technical premium, loadings and final premium on the quote record
sop: Enter the technical premium exactly as produced by the model.
Enter each loading applied and the resulting final quoted premium.
Done when all three premium components are shown on the quote record.
verify: Recompute technical premium plus loadings and compare to the final premium.
Pass when technical plus loadings equals the recorded final premium.

steps.title: Populate the per-section premium allocation in the policy administration system
sop: Enter the model allocation for each section line by line.
Do not smooth or reallocate premium between sections.
Done when every section carries its model-produced premium.
verify: Sum the section premiums and compare to the model total.
Pass when the summed section premiums equal the model total premium.

steps.title: Record any override of the model price with reason and deviation
sop: Where the quoted price differs from the model, record the override reason.
Quantify the deviation in both percentage and absolute terms.
Route the override to referral where it exceeds authority.
Done when every override carries a reason and a quantified deviation.
verify: Recompute the deviation from model output and quoted premium.
Pass when the recorded deviation matches the recomputed difference.

steps.title: Apply commission and broker fee at the agreed rate
sop: Read the agreed commission rate from the broker agreement on the account.
Apply that rate on the quote and enter any agreed broker fee.
Done when commission and fee on the quote match the agreement.
verify: Recompute commission from the premium and the agreed rate.
Pass when the recomputed commission equals the amount on the quote.

steps.title: Stamp the model run ID and model version on the quote
sop: Enter the model run ID and model version into the quote reference fields.
Attach the model output to the quote record.
Done when run ID, model version and output are all held on the quote.
verify: Resolve the stamped run ID back to the Earnix run and compare premiums.
Pass when the stamped run ID resolves to the run that produced the quoted premium.

generic.Defined scope/population: Quotes carrying a set release flag that are ready for issue to the broker.
generic.In-scope period: From setting of the release flag to the stated quote expiry date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Quote PDF, form schedule, subjectivity list, expiry date, issue timestamp and diary date all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of quotes at status Issued equals count of quote packs visible to brokers on the portal.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issued quote pack retained with version number, release date and time and the releasing user.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Quotes released without an expiry date are logged and reissued with the expiry stated.
generic.Test population: Quotes released to brokers through the portal during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any issued quote lacks a stated expiry date or is not visible to the broker on the portal.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed portal uploads return to the Underwriting Assistant to re-upload before the quote is treated as issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Issued quote document visible to the broker with a stated expiry date and a diary follow-up set.
generic.Evidence location: Broker & Agent Portal quote pack linked to the policy administration system quote record.

steps.title: Confirm the release flag is set on the policy administration system quote
sop: Open the quote and confirm the pre-release check has set the release flag.
Do not release a quote where the flag is not set.
Done when the release flag is confirmed set.
verify: Read the release flag and the checklist completion status.
Pass when the release flag is set and the checklist shows no open items.

steps.title: Upload the quote PDF, form schedule and subjectivity list to Broker & Agent Portal
sop: Upload the quote PDF against the broker account on the portal.
Upload the form schedule and the subjectivity list alongside it.
Done when all three documents are uploaded to the portal.
verify: List the uploaded documents on the portal against the intended pack.
Pass when all three documents appear on the portal against the account.

steps.title: State the quote expiry date in the covering message and on the document
sop: Write the covering message stating the quote expiry date.
Confirm the same expiry date is printed on the quote document.
Done when the expiry date appears in both places and they agree.
verify: Compare the expiry date in the message to the date on the document.
Pass when both expiry dates are present and identical.

steps.title: State in the message that cover is not bound until written confirmation
sop: Insert the standard wording that cover attaches only on written binding confirmation.
Confirm the wording appears before the message is sent.
Done when the not-bound wording is present in the covering message.
verify: Read the sent message for the not-bound wording.
Pass when the not-bound wording appears in the issued message.

steps.title: Move the quote status to Issued with a release timestamp
sop: Set the quote status to Issued in the policy administration system.
Confirm the release date and time are stamped on the record.
Done when the quote reads Issued with a release timestamp.
verify: Compare the release timestamp to the portal upload time.
Pass when the release timestamp is consistent with the portal upload.

steps.title: Set the diary to follow up ahead of the quote expiry date
sop: Create a follow-up diary task dated before the quote expiry.
Assign the task to the underwriter of record by name.
Done when an open diary task exists dated before expiry.
verify: Compare the diary due date to the stated quote expiry date.
Pass when the diary due date falls before the quote expiry date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every quote awaiting release that must be tested against the underwriter authority matrix.
generic.In-scope period: From completion of pricing to the setting of the quote release flag.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Quoted premium, largest limit, class of business, authority outcome and any referral link all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of quotes exceeding a threshold equals count of quotes with a linked referral approval.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Authority check entry retained with the matrix version used, checker name and check timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Threshold breaches without an approval are logged as blocked and dispositioned by referral or repricing.
generic.Test population: Quotes with a recorded authority check outcome during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any quote flagged Referred is released without a linked and approved referral record.
generic.Exception handling path: Referred quotes are held unreleased until the Senior Underwriter records the approval on the quote.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Authority check result recorded with a linked referral approval for every exceeded threshold.
generic.Evidence location: Authority check entry on the underwriting workstation quote record with the linked referral approval.

steps.title: Read the underwriter premium authority for the line in the workstation
sop: Open the authority matrix for the line and the quoting underwriter.
Note the premium authority limit and the matrix version.
Done when the applicable premium authority limit is identified.
verify: Confirm the matrix version read is the current published version.
Pass when the authority limit is taken from the current matrix version.

steps.title: Compare the quoted premium to the premium authority limit
sop: Take the final quoted premium including taxes and fees where the matrix so defines it.
Compare it to the underwriter premium authority.
Record whether the premium exceeds authority.
Done when the premium comparison result is recorded.
verify: Recompute the premium comparison against the authority limit.
Pass when the recorded result matches the recomputed comparison.

steps.title: Compare the largest limit and line size to the per-risk authority cap
sop: Identify the largest limit and the net line size being offered.
Compare both to the per-risk authority cap for the class.
Record whether either exceeds the cap.
Done when the limit and line size comparison is recorded.
verify: Recompute the largest limit and line size from the quote structure.
Pass when the recorded values equal the values on the quote structure.

steps.title: Test the class of business against restricted-class referral triggers
sop: Check the quoted class against the named restricted-class referral list.
Record any restricted-class hit on the authority check entry.
Done when the restricted-class test result is recorded.
verify: Confirm the test names the class code and the list version used.
Pass when the restricted-class test result names the class code and list version.

steps.title: Attach the referral approval where a threshold is exceeded
sop: Raise the referral for each exceeded threshold in the workstation.
Record the approver name, level and decision date on the referral.
Link the approved referral to the quote in the policy administration system.
Done when every exceeded threshold has a linked approved referral.
verify: Count exceeded thresholds against linked approved referrals.
Pass when every exceeded threshold has a linked approved referral.

steps.title: Flag the authority check outcome as Pass or Referred on the quote record
sop: Set the authority outcome flag to Pass or Referred.
Do not set the release flag while the outcome is Referred without approval.
Done when the authority outcome flag is set on the quote record.
verify: Read the authority flag together with the release flag state.
Pass when no quote flagged Referred without approval carries a set release flag.

generic.Defined scope/population: Package quotes where a filed package discount or surcharge is being applied across participating lines.
generic.In-scope period: From cross-line pricing agreement to the locking of the package rate for the quote.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Qualifying line combination, modifier percentage, per-line allocation, minimum premium test and reason all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of allocated modifier amounts across lines equals the total package modifier applied.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rating worksheet retained with the modifier, its allocation and the packaging table version used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Modifiers applied without the qualifying line combination are logged and removed before rate lock.
generic.Test population: Package quotes with a package modifier applied during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the modifier sits outside the filed packaging table range or has no recorded justification.
generic.Exception handling path: Out-of-range modifiers block the package rate lock and route to the Senior Underwriter for decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Package modifier within the filed range with a recorded justification and a per-line allocation.
generic.Evidence location: Earnix rating worksheet for the package linked to the Guidewire PolicyCenter package quote.

steps.title: Confirm the qualifying line combination on the Guidewire PolicyCenter package quote
sop: List the participating lines actually being quoted on the package.
Compare that list to the qualifying combinations in the packaging rules.
Do not apply a modifier where the qualifying combination is absent.
Done when the qualifying combination is confirmed present or absent.
verify: Match the quoted line list to the qualifying combination definition.
Pass when the quoted lines satisfy a defined qualifying combination.

steps.title: Read the applicable percentage from the filed packaging table
sop: Open the filed packaging table for the qualifying combination.
Read the permitted discount or surcharge range.
Select a percentage inside that range.
Done when a percentage inside the filed range has been selected.
verify: Compare the selected percentage to the filed range endpoints.
Pass when the selected percentage lies inside the filed range.

steps.title: Apply the modifier in Earnix Rating & Pricing
sop: Enter the package modifier into the package rating scenario.
Re-run the package rating so the modified premium is produced by the tool.
Capture the resulting run ID.
Done when a completed run reflects the applied package modifier.
verify: Compare the pre and post modifier premiums from the run output.
Pass when the premium movement equals the applied modifier percentage.

steps.title: Allocate the modifier across participating lines
sop: Spread the modifier across participating lines rather than loading one section.
Record the allocated amount for each participating line.
Done when every participating line carries its allocated share.
verify: Sum the per-line allocations and compare to the total modifier amount.
Pass when the summed allocations equal the total modifier amount.

steps.title: Re-test minimum premium per line after the modifier
sop: Compare each post-modifier line premium to that line filed minimum premium.
Restore any line premium that has fallen below its minimum.
Done when no line premium sits below its filed minimum.
verify: Recompute each line premium against its filed minimum.
Pass when every line premium is at or above its filed minimum.

steps.title: Record the reason for the package credit or debit on the rating worksheet
sop: Write the justification for the chosen modifier level on the worksheet.
Name the qualifying combination and the risk features relied on.
Done when a written justification is saved on the rating worksheet.
verify: Read the justification and confirm it is specific to this package.
Pass when the worksheet carries a package-specific written justification.

generic.Defined scope/population: Package accounts spanning more than one line that require a single lead underwriter for broker negotiation.
generic.In-scope period: From identification of the package account to the release of any line-level pricing.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Lead underwriter name, lead authority check, participating line underwriters and broker notification all recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of participating lines equals count of named line underwriters on the package header.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assignment entry retained on the package header with assigning manager, name and assignment timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Package accounts found without a lead are logged and a lead is assigned before any pricing is released.
generic.Test population: Package account headers created in the underwriting workstation during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any package account released pricing before a named lead underwriter was recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: Unassigned packages escalate to the Underwriting Director for immediate assignment before broker contact.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Named lead underwriter recorded on the package header with participating line underwriters listed.
generic.Evidence location: Package account header in the underwriting workstation mirrored to the CRM account record.

steps.title: Identify the package account on the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the package account header created from the submission.
Confirm more than one line of business is being quoted.
Done when the account is confirmed as a package requiring a lead.
verify: Count the lines listed against the package header.
Pass when two or more lines are recorded on the package header.

steps.title: Check candidate lead authority against the largest participating line
sop: Identify the largest participating line by premium and limit.
Check the candidate lead authority covers that line size.
Reject any candidate whose authority is insufficient.
Done when a candidate with sufficient authority is identified.
verify: Compare the candidate authority limit to the largest line premium and limit.
Pass when the candidate authority covers the largest participating line.

steps.title: Name the lead underwriter on the package account header
sop: Enter the lead underwriter name in the lead field on the package header.
Save the assignment so it is stamped with assigner and date.
Done when the package header names the lead underwriter.
verify: Read the lead field and its assignment stamp on the header.
Pass when a named lead underwriter is recorded with an assignment stamp.

steps.title: List participating line underwriters against their sections
sop: Assign a named underwriter to each participating line section.
Record each assignment on the package header.
Done when every participating line has a named underwriter.
verify: Count participating lines against named line underwriters.
Pass when every participating line carries a named underwriter.

steps.title: Tell the broker in writing who the single point of contact is
sop: Send the broker a written notification naming the lead underwriter.
State that all package negotiation runs through that contact.
Log the notification on the CRM (Salesforce/Dynamics) account.
Done when the notification is sent and logged in CRM.
verify: Open the CRM activity and confirm the notification names the lead.
Pass when a logged CRM activity names the lead underwriter to the broker.

steps.title: Confirm the assignment precedes any line-level pricing release
sop: Compare the lead assignment timestamp to the first pricing release on any line.
Escalate where pricing was released before the assignment.
Done when the ordering has been checked and any breach escalated.
verify: Read the assignment timestamp against the earliest line pricing release time.
Pass when the lead assignment predates every line pricing release.

generic.Defined scope/population: Package accounts where all participating lines are priced and approved and a single quote must be compiled.
generic.In-scope period: From the last participating line approval to the compiled package quote being ready for release.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Per-line sections, per-line premium, combined premium, combined subjectivities and package expiry all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of per-line premiums in the compiled quote equals the combined package premium shown.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Compiled package quote filed in OpenText with version number and compilation timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing line sections are logged and the quote is recompiled before it is released.
generic.Test population: Package quotes compiled during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any participating line is absent from the compiled quote or expiry dates differ between sections.
generic.Exception handling path: Incomplete compilations return to the Underwriting Assistant for recompilation before release.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: One compiled package quote containing every participating line section and a combined premium.
generic.Evidence location: Compiled package quote in OpenText Document Mgmt linked to the policy administration system package quote.

steps.title: List the approved participating lines on the policy administration system package quote
sop: Open the package quote and list every participating line with an approval.
Exclude any line that has not been approved.
Done when the list of approved participating lines is complete.
verify: Compare the list to the participating lines on the package header.
Pass when every approved line on the header appears on the list.

steps.title: Reproduce each line coverage summary in its own section
sop: Create a document section for each participating line.
Reproduce the coverage summary, limits and deductibles for that line.
Done when every participating line has its own complete section.
verify: Count document sections against approved participating lines.
Pass when the section count equals the approved participating line count.

steps.title: Show per-line premium and the combined package premium
sop: Show the premium for each line in its section.
Show the combined package premium on the summary page.
Done when both per-line and combined premiums are displayed.
verify: Sum the per-line premiums and compare to the combined figure.
Pass when the summed per-line premiums equal the combined package premium.

steps.title: De-duplicate the combined subjectivity list across lines
sop: Merge the subjectivity lists from every participating line.
Remove duplicate requirements that appear on more than one line.
Keep the earliest due date where duplicates had different dates.
Done when a single de-duplicated subjectivity list exists.
verify: Scan the merged list for repeated requirements.
Pass when no requirement appears more than once on the combined list.

steps.title: State shared aggregate limits and how they apply across lines
sop: Identify any aggregate limit shared between participating lines.
State explicitly which sections erode the shared aggregate.
Done when every shared aggregate is described in the quote.
verify: Read the shared aggregate wording against the rated structure.
Pass when every shared aggregate on the structure is described in the quote.

steps.title: Apply one package expiry date consistently and file the compiled quote
sop: Set a single package expiry date across all sections.
Generate the compiled quote document and file it in OpenText Document Mgmt.
Link the filed document to the package quote record.
Done when the filed compiled quote shows one consistent expiry date.
verify: Check the expiry date printed in each section of the filed document.
Pass when every section shows the same package expiry date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Package quotes awaiting release where each participating line must hold its own authority approval.
generic.In-scope period: From the first line approval to the setting of the package release flag.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Approval record, approver name and level per line, combined aggregate test and approval references all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of participating line sections equals count of recorded line approvals on the package record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each line approval retained with approver name, level and approval timestamp against the quote version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Sections without an approval are logged as blocking and dispositioned by approval or removal from the package.
generic.Test population: Package quotes released during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any participating line section is released without a recorded approval at the required level.
generic.Exception handling path: Outstanding approvals block the package release flag until the Senior Underwriter records the decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No participating line section remains without a recorded approval at the correct authority level.
generic.Evidence location: Approval references on the package quote record in the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: List participating line sections on the package quote record
sop: Open the package quote in the underwriting workstation.
List every participating line section that will be released.
Done when the full section list is captured.
verify: Compare the section list to the compiled package quote document.
Pass when the section list matches the compiled quote sections.

steps.title: Check an approval record exists for each participating line section
sop: Open the approval entry for each listed section.
Note any section with no approval record.
Done when every section is marked as approved or missing.
verify: Count sections with an approval record against total sections.
Pass when every section either has an approval or is marked as missing.

steps.title: Check each approver authority against that section premium and limit
sop: Read the approver level recorded on each section approval.
Compare it to the section premium and largest limit.
Re-refer any section approved below the required level.
Done when every approval is at or above the required level.
verify: Recompute the required level from section premium and limit.
Pass when every recorded approver level meets the recomputed requirement.

steps.title: Refer the cross-line aggregate exposure to the combined authority
sop: Total the exposure across all participating lines for the same insured.
Compare the combined figure to the combined authority threshold.
Raise a referral where the combined exposure exceeds that threshold.
Done when the combined aggregate has been tested and referred if required.
verify: Recompute the combined exposure from the participating line limits.
Pass when the combined exposure is either within authority or carries a referral.

steps.title: Hold the package release flag while approvals are outstanding
sop: Leave the package release flag unset while any section approval is missing.
Chase the responsible line underwriter for the outstanding approval.
Done when no outstanding approval remains against the package.
verify: Read the release flag together with the outstanding approvals list.
Pass when the release flag is unset wherever an approval is outstanding.

steps.title: List approval references on the package quote record
sop: Enter every line approval reference onto the package quote record.
Link each reference to its underlying approval entry.
Done when all approval references are listed and linked.
verify: Resolve each listed reference back to its approval entry.
Pass when every listed reference resolves to a recorded approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: Package accounts spanning property, liability and specialty desks requiring an agreed cross-line price.
generic.In-scope period: From the first line technical rating to the agreed per-line allocation on the rating worksheet.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Technical premium per line, final premium per line, shortfall amount and agreement record all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of agreed per-line premiums equals the aggregate package premium on the rating worksheet.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Cross-line pricing agreement retained with each line underwriter name and the agreement timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Lines priced below technical rate are logged with the shortfall and dispositioned by agreement or repricing.
generic.Test population: Package accounts with a cross-line pricing agreement during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any participating line lacks a recorded technical premium or a recorded final premium.
generic.Exception handling path: Unagreed line pricing escalates to the Senior Underwriter before the package premium is fixed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Technical and final premium recorded per participating line with the deviation shown for each.
generic.Evidence location: Cross-line rating worksheet in Earnix Rating & Pricing linked to the workstation package record.

steps.title: Capture the technical premium per line in Earnix Rating & Pricing
sop: Run each participating line at its technical rate before any package adjustment.
Record the technical premium for each line on the cross-line worksheet.
Done when every participating line has a recorded technical premium.
verify: Count lines with a technical premium against participating lines.
Pass when every participating line has a recorded technical premium.

steps.title: Identify lines priced below technical rate and quantify the shortfall
sop: Compare each proposed line price to its technical premium.
Record the shortfall amount and percentage where the price is lower.
Done when every below-technical line carries a quantified shortfall.
verify: Recompute each shortfall from technical and proposed premiums.
Pass when recorded shortfalls equal the recomputed differences.

steps.title: Test the aggregate package premium against the combined target loss ratio
sop: Total the proposed premiums across all participating lines.
Compare the implied combined loss ratio to the target for the package.
Reprice lines where the combined position misses the target.
Done when the combined position is tested against target.
verify: Recompute the implied combined loss ratio from the proposed premiums.
Pass when the recomputed ratio is recorded and compared to target.

steps.title: Agree the cross-line price with each line underwriter
sop: Discuss the proposed price for each line with its owning underwriter.
Record each underwriter agreement or objection on the workstation package record.
Resolve objections before fixing the package price.
Done when every line underwriter has recorded agreement.
verify: Count recorded agreements against participating lines.
Pass when every participating line carries a recorded underwriter agreement.

steps.title: Enter the agreed per-line allocation into the rating worksheet
sop: Enter the agreed final premium for each line into the worksheet.
Confirm the allocation sums to the intended package premium.
Done when the agreed allocation is recorded for every line.
verify: Sum the agreed per-line premiums and compare to the package premium.
Pass when the summed allocation equals the package premium.

steps.title: Record the deviation from technical premium per line on the workstation record
sop: Record the difference between technical and final premium for each line.
Show the deviation in both amount and percentage.
Done when every line shows its deviation from technical premium.
verify: Recompute each deviation from the stored technical and final premiums.
Pass when every recorded deviation matches the recomputed value.

generic.Defined scope/population: Package submissions requiring every requested coverage to be decomposed into product and line codes.
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of the package submission to the final line list on the package account header.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Requested coverage list, product or line code, owning desk, appetite flag and data completeness all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of requested coverages equals count of coverages mapped to a product or line code.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Line decomposition list retained on the package header with author and decomposition date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Coverages outside appetite or not written are logged and dispositioned as declined or referred.
generic.Test population: Package submissions decomposed during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any requested coverage is left without a product or line code and an owning desk.
generic.Exception handling path: Unmapped coverages return to the Underwriter to map, refer to a specialty desk or decline.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every requested coverage is mapped to a product or line code with a named owning desk.
generic.Evidence location: Line decomposition list on the package account header in the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Extract the requested coverage list from Broker & Agent Portal
sop: Open the package submission on the portal and read the coverages requested.
List each requested coverage separately, including add-on extensions.
Done when every requested coverage appears on the list.
verify: Compare the list to the coverages named in the broker submission document.
Pass when every coverage named by the broker appears on the list.

steps.title: Map each requested coverage to a product or line code
sop: Look up each requested coverage in the product and line code catalogue.
Record the product or line code against each coverage.
Mark any coverage with no matching code.
Done when every coverage carries a code or an explicit no-match mark.
verify: Count mapped coverages against total requested coverages.
Pass when no coverage is left unmapped and unmarked.

steps.title: Flag lines outside appetite or not written by the carrier
sop: Test each mapped line against the appetite and product availability lists.
Flag lines the carrier does not write or that fall outside appetite.
Tell the broker immediately which requested lines cannot be quoted.
Done when every out-of-scope line is flagged and communicated.
verify: Read the flagged lines against the appetite and product lists.
Pass when every line outside appetite or product scope is flagged.

steps.title: Route specialty desk lines to their owning desks
sop: Identify lines requiring a specialty desk such as cyber, directors and officers or marine.
Route each to the owning desk queue in the underwriting workstation.
Done when every specialty line sits in its owning desk queue.
verify: Read the queue assignment for each specialty line.
Pass when every specialty line is assigned to its correct owning desk.

steps.title: Check per-line exposure data completeness against line minimum requirements
sop: For each mapped line, check the minimum data required to rate it is present.
List the missing items per line for broker chase.
Done when every line has a completeness result and any gap list.
verify: Count lines with a completeness result against total mapped lines.
Pass when every mapped line carries a completeness result.

steps.title: Record the final line list on the package account header
sop: Enter the final list of quotable lines with their codes and owning desks.
Record the lines excluded and the reason for exclusion.
Done when the package header carries the final line list and exclusions.
verify: Compare the header list plus exclusions to the original requested coverage list.
Pass when every requested coverage appears either as quotable or excluded with a reason.

generic.Defined scope/population: Package accounts with an agreed cross-line price that require a composition record in the underwriting file.
generic.In-scope period: From the agreed per-line allocation to the release of the compiled package quote.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Per-line premium, limit, deductible, package modifier amount, shared limits and note attribution all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of per-line premium contributions equals the quoted package premium on the quote record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Composition note retained with lead underwriter attribution, note date and the quote version described.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reconciliation differences between line contributions and package premium are logged and corrected.
generic.Test population: Package accounts with a composition note recorded during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if per-line contributions do not sum to the quoted package premium within rounding tolerance.
generic.Exception handling path: Unreconciled composition notes return to the Underwriting Assistant for correction before release.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Per-line contributions recorded and reconciling to the total quoted package premium.
generic.Evidence location: Composition note on the workstation package record and the policy administration system quote.

steps.title: List each participating line with premium, limit and deductible
sop: Read the agreed allocation from the cross-line rating worksheet.
List each line with its premium, limit and deductible in the composition note.
Done when every participating line is listed with its figures.
verify: Compare each listed line to the rating worksheet allocation.
Pass when every listed line matches the worksheet allocation.

steps.title: Reconcile per-line contributions to the quoted package premium
sop: Sum the per-line premium contributions in the composition note.
Compare the sum to the quoted package premium on the quote record.
Investigate and correct any difference beyond rounding.
Done when the contributions reconcile to the quoted package premium.
verify: Recompute the sum of contributions and compare to the package premium.
Pass when the recomputed sum equals the quoted package premium.

steps.title: Show the package modifier separately from technical premiums
sop: Record the package modifier amount as a distinct line in the note.
Show the technical premium totals before the modifier is applied.
Done when the modifier is shown separately from technical premium.
verify: Check the note shows technical premium, modifier and final premium separately.
Pass when all three figures appear as distinct lines in the note.

steps.title: Describe shared limits and inter-line aggregates in the file note
sop: Describe any limit shared across participating lines.
State how the aggregate erodes across those lines.
Done when every shared limit and aggregate is described.
verify: Compare the described shared limits to the rated structure.
Pass when every shared limit in the structure is described in the note.

steps.title: Attribute and date the composition note to the lead underwriter
sop: Record the lead underwriter name against the composition note.
Date the note on the day the composition was agreed.
Done when the note carries lead underwriter attribution and a date.
verify: Compare the attributed name to the lead recorded on the package header.
Pass when the note attribution matches the recorded package lead.

steps.title: File the composition note against the package record in the policy administration system
sop: Attach the composition note to the package quote in the policy administration system.
Link the note from the workstation package record.
Done when the note is attached and reachable from both systems.
verify: Open the note from each system and confirm it is the same version.
Pass when the same note version opens from both the workstation and the quote.

generic.Defined scope/population: Package structures where sections could overlap, leave gaps or need cross-liability provisions.
generic.In-scope period: From compilation of the package structure to the pre-release check on the package quote.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Overlap list, responding section, other-insurance review, cross-liability provision and gap disposition all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of identified overlaps and gaps equals count of recorded resolutions against form numbers.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Resolution notes retained against affected form numbers with author and resolution date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Gaps left deliberately uninsured are logged with an explicit client-informed disposition.
generic.Test population: Package quotes with an inter-line coverage review during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any identified overlap or gap has no endorsement or file note addressing it.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved overlaps route to the Senior Underwriter for a wording decision before release.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Endorsements or file notes exist addressing each identified overlap or gap in the package structure.
generic.Evidence location: Resolution notes in OpenText Document Mgmt linked to the policy administration system package quote.

steps.title: Identify overlapping coverage between sections on the package quote
sop: Read the coverage grants of each participating section side by side.
List every point where two sections could respond to the same loss.
Done when the overlap list is complete for the package.
verify: Check the overlap list covers every pair of participating sections.
Pass when every section pair has been compared and recorded.

steps.title: State the intended responding section for each overlap
sop: Decide which section is intended to respond for each overlap.
Record the intended responding section against the overlap.
Done when every overlap names its intended responding section.
verify: Read each overlap entry for a named responding section.
Pass when no overlap is left without a named responding section.

steps.title: Review other-insurance and non-contribution clauses across sections
sop: Read the other-insurance and non-contribution clauses in each section wording.
Identify clauses that would push the loss away from the intended section.
Amend or endorse to align with the intended response.
Done when the clauses align with the intended responding sections.
verify: Re-read the clauses against the intended responding sections.
Pass when no clause contradicts the intended responding section.

steps.title: Confirm cross-liability or separation-of-insureds where multiple named insureds exist
sop: Check whether the package carries more than one named insured.
Confirm the cross-liability or separation-of-insureds provision is present where needed.
Add the provision by endorsement where it is missing.
Done when the provision is present wherever multiple named insureds exist.
verify: Read the named insured schedule and the attached provision.
Pass when multiple named insureds are matched by the required provision.

steps.title: Close gaps between sections by endorsement or record them as uninsured
sop: Identify exposures falling between sections such as property versus equipment breakdown.
Close each gap by endorsement where the carrier will cover it.
Record the remainder explicitly as deliberately uninsured.
Done when every identified gap is either closed or recorded as uninsured.
verify: Count identified gaps against endorsements added plus uninsured notes.
Pass when every identified gap has an endorsement or an uninsured note.

steps.title: Record each resolution against the affected form number in OpenText
sop: Write each resolution note naming the form number it affects.
File the notes in OpenText Document Mgmt against the package reference.
Link the notes from the policy administration system package quote.
Done when every resolution is filed against its form number.
verify: Resolve each resolution note to a form number on the package schedule.
Pass when every resolution note names a form present on the schedule.

generic.Defined scope/population: Package quotes with two or more participating sections requiring a consistency check before release.
generic.In-scope period: From compilation of the package quote to the setting of the package release flag.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Named insured schedule, policy period, territory wording, deductible basis and check outcome all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of participating sections equals count of sections checked for insured and period consistency.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Consistency check outcome retained on the package quote record with checker name and check date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Deliberate differences between sections are logged with a stated reason rather than silently left.
generic.Test population: Package quotes with a recorded consistency check during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if named insured or policy period differs between sections without a recorded deliberate reason.
generic.Exception handling path: Inconsistencies return to the Underwriting Assistant for correction and are re-checked before release.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No mismatch in named insured or policy period across participating sections at release.
generic.Evidence location: Consistency check entry on the package quote record in the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Compare named insured and additional insured schedules across sections
sop: Extract the named and additional insured schedules from each section.
Compare the entity names and spellings across sections.
Correct any difference in the policy administration system.
Done when the insured schedules are identical across sections.
verify: Re-extract the schedules and compare them entity by entity.
Pass when the insured schedules are identical across all sections.

steps.title: Compare policy period and inception date across sections
sop: Read the inception date and policy period on each section.
Correct any section that differs from the package period.
Done when every section carries the same policy period.
verify: Re-read the inception and expiry dates on each section.
Pass when every section carries the identical policy period.

steps.title: Compare territory and jurisdiction wording between sections
sop: Read the territory and jurisdiction wording in each section.
Identify any section with a narrower or wider territory than intended.
Align the wording or record why it deliberately differs.
Done when territory wording is aligned or the difference is recorded.
verify: Compare the territory wording across sections after amendment.
Pass when territory wording is consistent or its difference is recorded.

steps.title: Compare deductible basis across sections
sop: Read whether each section deductible applies per occurrence or in the aggregate.
Align the basis where inconsistency is unintended.
State deliberately different bases explicitly in the quote.
Done when the deductible basis is consistent or explicitly stated as differing.
verify: Read the deductible basis on each section after amendment.
Pass when the basis is consistent or its difference is explicitly stated.

steps.title: Log any deliberate difference with its reason
sop: List each difference that is intentional rather than an error.
Record the underwriting reason for each intentional difference.
Done when every intentional difference carries a recorded reason.
verify: Read the logged differences and their recorded reasons.
Pass when no logged difference is left without a reason.

steps.title: Record the consistency check outcome on the package quote record
sop: Record the check outcome on the package quote record in the workstation.
Stamp the check with checker name and date.
Done when the outcome and its stamp are saved on the record.
verify: Read the outcome, checker name and check date on the record.
Pass when the outcome is recorded with a checker name and date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Broker counter-proposals received against issued quotes that require an underwriting assessment.
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of the counter-proposal to the recorded recommendation on the negotiation log.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Requested premium, price gap, requested extensions, treaty impact, revised loss ratio and recommendation all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of logged counter-proposals equals count of recorded assessments on the negotiation log.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assessment entry retained with the rating scenario referenced, assessor name and assessment date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Counter-proposals that breach appetite are logged and dispositioned as decline rather than being priced.
generic.Test population: Counter-proposals assessed during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any assessment omits the quantified gap to technical price or a stated recommendation.
generic.Exception handling path: Assessments without a quantified gap return to the Underwriter before any counter is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assessment entry shows the technical price gap and an accept, counter or decline recommendation.
generic.Evidence location: Negotiation log entry on the underwriting workstation quote record.

steps.title: Compare the requested premium to the technical and floor price in Earnix
sop: Read the technical premium and pricing floor from the rating scenario.
Compare the broker requested premium to both figures.
Quantify the gap in amount and percentage.
Done when the gap to technical and floor price is quantified.
verify: Recompute the gap from the requested premium and technical price.
Pass when the recorded gap matches the recomputed difference.

steps.title: Check requested coverage extensions against appetite and the filed form set
sop: List each coverage extension the broker has requested.
Test each against appetite and against the filed form set.
Mark extensions that cannot be offered.
Done when every requested extension has an appetite and form result.
verify: Count extensions tested against extensions requested.
Pass when every requested extension carries an appetite and form result.

steps.title: Assess the impact on treaty cession and any facultative need
sop: Test the counter-proposed limits against the treaty cession rules.
Identify whether facultative reinsurance would be needed.
Record the reinsurance consequence of accepting the counter-proposal.
Done when the treaty and facultative impact is recorded.
verify: Read the recorded impact against the treaty cession rules.
Pass when the record states the treaty position and any facultative need.

steps.title: Recalculate the expected loss ratio at the counter-proposed terms
sop: Build a rating scenario reflecting the counter-proposed premium and terms.
Read the expected loss ratio produced at those terms.
Compare it to the target loss ratio for the class.
Done when the expected loss ratio at counter-proposed terms is recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded loss ratio to the scenario output in Earnix.
Pass when the recorded loss ratio matches the referenced scenario output.

steps.title: Form the accept, counter or decline recommendation
sop: Weigh the price gap, extension results, treaty impact and loss ratio together.
Choose accept, counter or decline and state the reasoning.
Done when a single recommendation with reasoning is formed.
verify: Read the recommendation and confirm it references the assessed factors.
Pass when the recommendation cites the price gap and at least one other factor.

steps.title: Record the assessment and recommendation on the negotiation log
sop: Create the assessment entry on the negotiation log in the workstation.
Record the quantified gap, the tested extensions and the recommendation.
Stamp the entry with assessor name and date.
Done when the assessment entry is saved on the negotiation log.
verify: Open the log entry and check the gap, extensions and recommendation are present.
Pass when the log entry carries the gap, extension results and recommendation.

generic.Defined scope/population: Quotes in negotiation where the broker has reported competing terms from another market.
generic.In-scope period: From the broker report of competing terms to the recorded hold, match or walk-away decision.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Competitor carrier, premium, limits, deductible, adjusted comparison and decision all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of reported competing quotes equals count of like-for-like comparisons recorded.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Comparison entry retained with the benchmark version used, assessor name and assessment date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Competing terms reported without limits or deductibles are logged and chased before comparison.
generic.Test population: Quotes with recorded competing market terms during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a price concession was made without a recorded like-for-like adjusted comparison.
generic.Exception handling path: Concessions made without comparison escalate to the Senior Underwriter for retrospective review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Competing market terms recorded with a like-for-like adjusted comparison and a stated decision.
generic.Evidence location: Market comparison entry on the underwriting workstation quote record.

steps.title: Record the competing terms reported by the broker on the quote record
sop: Capture the competing carrier name, premium, limits and deductible as reported.
Record that the terms are as reported by the broker and unverified.
Done when the reported competing terms are stored on the quote record.
verify: Read the stored terms against the broker communication.
Pass when the stored competing terms match the broker report.

steps.title: Adjust the comparison for differences in limits and coverage
sop: Identify differences in limits, deductibles and coverage between the two offers.
Adjust the competing premium to a like-for-like basis with our quote.
Record the adjustments made and their basis.
Done when a like-for-like adjusted comparison exists.
verify: Recompute the adjusted competing premium from the recorded adjustments.
Pass when the recorded adjusted figure matches the recomputation.

steps.title: Compare rate per unit of exposure to the carrier benchmark in Earnix
sop: Compute our rate per unit of exposure for the class from the rating scenario.
Compare it to the carrier benchmark rate for that class in Earnix Rating & Pricing.
Record whether our rate sits above, at or below benchmark.
Done when the benchmark comparison is recorded.
verify: Recompute the rate per unit of exposure from the rated exposure and premium.
Pass when the recomputed rate matches the recorded rate used in comparison.

steps.title: Consider the segment hit ratio position before conceding on price
sop: Read the current hit ratio for the segment on the workstation reporting view.
Weigh whether the segment position justifies a price concession.
Record the hit ratio considered and its influence on the decision.
Done when the hit ratio position has been recorded against the decision.
verify: Check the recorded hit ratio against the reporting view for the segment.
Pass when the recorded hit ratio matches the reported segment figure.

steps.title: Decide whether to hold, match within authority or walk away
sop: Weigh the adjusted comparison, benchmark position and hit ratio together.
Choose hold, match within authority or walk away.
Confirm any match sits inside the underwriter authority before committing.
Done when a single decision is chosen and authority-checked.
verify: Test any matched price against the authority limit for the line.
Pass when the chosen decision sits within the applicable authority.

steps.title: Record the price adequacy decision on the workstation quote record
sop: Record the decision, the adjusted comparison and the reasoning on the quote record.
Stamp the entry with assessor name and date.
Done when the decision entry is saved on the quote record.
verify: Open the entry and confirm it holds the comparison and the decision.
Pass when the entry carries both the adjusted comparison and the decision.

generic.Defined scope/population: Broker requested concessions on live quotes that require a quantified pricing impact before any offer.
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of the concession request to the priced concession package on the rating worksheet.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Concession description, scenario reference, premium delta, cumulative effect and rule test all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of requested concessions equals count of separate rating scenarios created for them.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each concession scenario retained with its own run ID, run timestamp and rate table version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Concessions breaching filed rating rules are logged and excluded from the offer with a reason.
generic.Test population: Quotes with priced broker concessions during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the original rating scenario was overwritten or any concession lacks a premium delta.
generic.Exception handling path: Concessions priced without a separate scenario are rebuilt by the Underwriter before the offer is made.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A separate rating scenario exists per concession with its premium delta recorded on the worksheet.
generic.Evidence location: Concession scenarios in Earnix Rating & Pricing linked to the Guidewire PolicyCenter quote.

steps.title: List each requested concession from the broker response
sop: Itemise each concession such as deductible reduction, limit increase or exclusion removal.
Record each as a separate line on the concession list.
Done when every requested concession is listed separately.
verify: Compare the concession list to the broker request document.
Pass when every concession the broker asked for appears on the list.

steps.title: Create a separate rating scenario per concession in Earnix Rating & Pricing
sop: Copy the current approved scenario for each concession.
Apply only that single concession in its scenario.
Do not overwrite the original approved scenario.
Done when each concession has its own scenario.
verify: Count concession scenarios against listed concessions and confirm the original is intact.
Pass when each concession has its own scenario and the original is unchanged.

steps.title: Record the premium delta per concession on the rating worksheet
sop: Run each concession scenario and read the resulting premium.
Record the delta against the base premium for that concession.
Done when every concession carries a recorded premium delta.
verify: Recompute each delta from the base and concession scenario outputs.
Pass when every recorded delta matches the recomputed difference.

steps.title: Quantify the cumulative effect on final premium and rate adequacy
sop: Build a combined scenario applying all concessions being considered.
Read the cumulative premium and the resulting rate adequacy position.
Record the cumulative effect on the worksheet.
Done when the cumulative effect and adequacy position are recorded.
verify: Compare the cumulative scenario premium to the sum of individual deltas.
Pass when the cumulative position is recorded and reconciles to the individual deltas.

steps.title: Identify concessions that breach filed rating rules
sop: Test each concession against the filed rating rules and form set.
Mark any concession that cannot lawfully be offered.
Exclude those concessions from the offer package.
Done when every non-compliant concession is marked and excluded.
verify: Check the excluded list against the filed rating rules.
Pass when no concession breaching a filed rule remains in the offer package.

steps.title: Save the priced concession package as a new scenario on the quote
sop: Save the agreed concession package as a distinct scenario.
Link the scenario to the Guidewire PolicyCenter quote record.
Done when the priced concession package is saved and linked.
verify: Open the scenario from the quote record and confirm it holds the concession set.
Pass when the linked scenario reflects the concession package offered.

generic.Defined scope/population: Quotes where negotiation has concluded and final binding terms must be put to the broker.
generic.In-scope period: From the agreed final position to the stated validity date of the final terms.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Final premium, limits, deductibles, commission, subjectivities and validity date all stated in the message.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of concluded negotiations equals count of final terms messages logged in CRM.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Final terms message retained in CRM with send timestamp and the quote version it reflects.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Final terms sent without withdrawing prior offers are logged and corrected by a withdrawal message.
generic.Test population: Final terms messages issued to brokers during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the final terms message omits the validity date or the outstanding subjectivities.
generic.Exception handling path: Incomplete final terms return to the Underwriter for a corrected message before any binding is accepted.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Final terms message issued showing premium, subjectivities and a stated validity date.
generic.Evidence location: Broker & Agent Portal final terms message logged against the CRM opportunity.

steps.title: Confirm the agreed final position on the workstation negotiation log
sop: Read the final agreed position recorded on the negotiation log.
Confirm it matches the latest approved quote version.
Done when the final position is confirmed against the approved quote.
verify: Compare the log final position to the approved quote version figures.
Pass when the final position matches the approved quote version.

steps.title: State final premium, limits, deductibles and commission in one message
sop: Draft the final terms message in Broker & Agent Portal.
State the final premium, limits, deductibles and commission together.
Done when all four elements appear in the single draft message.
verify: Compare each stated figure to the approved quote record.
Pass when all four stated elements match the approved quote.

steps.title: Restate outstanding subjectivities with their due dates
sop: List the subjectivities still outstanding on the quote.
State the due date for each in the message.
Done when every outstanding subjectivity is restated with a due date.
verify: Count subjectivities in the message against outstanding items on the quote.
Pass when every outstanding subjectivity appears with a due date.

steps.title: State that cover attaches only on written confirmation of binding
sop: Insert the standard wording that cover attaches only on written binding confirmation.
Confirm the wording is present before sending.
Done when the binding caveat is present in the message.
verify: Read the message for the binding caveat wording.
Pass when the binding caveat appears in the issued message.

steps.title: State the validity date and withdraw superseded prior offers
sop: State the validity or expiry date of the final terms in the message.
State explicitly that all prior offers are withdrawn.
Done when validity date and withdrawal statement both appear.
verify: Read the message for the validity date and the withdrawal statement.
Pass when both the validity date and the withdrawal statement are present.

steps.title: Send the final terms and log the message on the CRM opportunity
sop: Send the final terms through Broker & Agent Portal.
Log the message as an activity on the CRM (Salesforce/Dynamics) opportunity.
Attach the final terms document to the activity.
Done when the message is sent and logged with its attachment.
verify: Open the CRM activity and confirm the attachment matches the sent message.
Pass when the logged CRM activity carries the sent final terms document.

generic.Defined scope/population: All quotes that entered negotiation and require a complete negotiation history in the underwriting file.
generic.In-scope period: From the first broker response on the quote to the recorded final agreed position.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Exchange date, channel, participants, offer premium, offer terms and final position marker all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of logged offers and counter-offers equals count of quote versions issued to the broker.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each log entry retained with date, author and the attached correspondence or quote version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Exchanges recalled from memory rather than evidenced are logged and marked as unsupported.
generic.Test population: Negotiated quotes closed during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any issued quote version has no corresponding negotiation log entry.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing log entries return to the Underwriting Assistant to reconstruct from correspondence before closure.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Dated entries exist for every offer and counter-offer, ending in a marked final agreed position.
generic.Evidence location: Negotiation log on the CRM opportunity mirrored to the underwriting workstation quote record.

steps.title: Log each broker exchange with date, channel and participants in CRM
sop: Create a CRM (Salesforce/Dynamics) activity for each broker exchange.
Record the date, channel and the names of everyone involved.
Done when every exchange has a dated CRM activity.
verify: Compare the logged exchange count to the correspondence held on file.
Pass when every piece of correspondence has a matching logged exchange.

steps.title: Record each offer and counter-offer with its premium and terms
sop: Record the premium and headline terms for each offer and counter-offer.
Keep each offer as its own entry rather than editing an earlier one.
Done when every offer and counter-offer has its own entry.
verify: Read each entry for a premium and headline terms.
Pass when no offer entry is missing its premium or terms.

steps.title: Mark the final agreed position as a distinct entry
sop: Create a clearly marked final agreed position entry on the log.
State the agreed premium, limits, deductibles and subjectivities.
Done when a single marked final position entry exists.
verify: Check there is exactly one entry marked as the final agreed position.
Pass when exactly one final agreed position entry exists on the log.

steps.title: Attach supporting emails and revised quote versions to the log
sop: Attach the supporting broker correspondence to its log entry.
Attach the quote version issued at each stage.
Done when each entry carries its supporting evidence.
verify: Open a sample of entries and confirm the attachments open.
Pass when each sampled entry carries the correspondence it describes.

steps.title: Reconcile the log to the quote version history in the workstation
sop: List the quote versions issued from the workstation quote record.
Match each version to a negotiation log entry.
Create any missing entry from the correspondence held.
Done when every issued version maps to a log entry.
verify: Count issued quote versions against negotiation log offer entries.
Pass when every issued version has a matching log entry.

steps.title: Mirror the completed log to the underwriting workstation quote record
sop: Link or copy the completed negotiation log onto the workstation quote record.
Confirm the final agreed position is visible from the quote record.
Done when the log is reachable from the workstation quote record.
verify: Open the log from the workstation record and check the final position entry.
Pass when the log opens from the quote record showing the final position.

generic.Defined scope/population: Negotiated quotes where the final price or terms differ from the technical position and need a rationale.
generic.In-scope period: From the agreed final position to closure of the quote file.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Technical price, final price, quantified deviation, non-price factors, approver reference and signature all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of quotes below technical price equals count of rationale notes quantifying the deviation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rationale note retained with underwriter name, date and the quote version it explains.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Deviations without an approver reference are logged and dispositioned by retrospective approval.
generic.Test population: Negotiated quotes concluded during the review period below technical price.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a below-technical price is recorded with no quantified deviation in the rationale.
generic.Exception handling path: Unquantified rationales return to the Underwriter for completion before the file is closed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Rationale note present quantifying any deviation from technical price and naming the factors relied on.
generic.Evidence location: Rationale note on the underwriting workstation quote record and the policy administration system quote.

steps.title: State the reason for the final price versus the technical price
sop: Read the technical price and the agreed final price from the quote record.
Write the reason the final price was accepted.
Done when the reason is written against both prices.
verify: Check the note names both the technical and the final price.
Pass when the note states both prices and the reason for the difference.

steps.title: Quantify any deviation from the pricing floor
sop: Read the pricing floor for the class from the rating scenario.
Calculate the deviation of the final price from that floor.
Record the deviation in amount and percentage.
Done when the deviation from floor is quantified in the note.
verify: Recompute the deviation from the floor and final price.
Pass when the recorded deviation matches the recomputed value.

steps.title: Name the non-price factors relied on
sop: Name the factors such as loss history, risk quality, multi-line spread or relationship value.
State how each factor supports accepting the final price.
Done when the non-price factors are named and explained.
verify: Read the note for named factors rather than generic wording.
Pass when the note names specific non-price factors for this account.

steps.title: Reference the approver where the rationale supports an authority deviation
sop: Identify whether the final price required an authority deviation.
Record the approver name and approval reference in the note.
Done when any authority deviation names its approver.
verify: Resolve the approval reference to the referral record on the quote.
Pass when the referenced approval resolves to a recorded referral decision.

steps.title: Sign the rationale note with underwriter name and date
sop: Add the underwriter name and the date the rationale was written.
Save the note against the workstation quote record.
Done when the note is signed and saved.
verify: Read the signature and date on the saved note.
Pass when the note carries an underwriter name and a date.

steps.title: Attach the rationale to the quote in the policy administration system
sop: Attach the signed rationale note to the quote in the policy administration system.
Confirm it is linked to the correct quote version.
Done when the rationale is attached against the correct quote version.
verify: Open the attachment from the quote and confirm the version referenced.
Pass when the attached rationale names the quote version it explains.

generic.Defined scope/population: All broker responses received against issued quotes, whether acceptance, decline or counter-proposal.
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of the broker response to the underwriter alert being raised.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Response classification, itemised changes, competitor position, decision deadline and quote status all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of broker responses received on the portal equals count classified on the quote records.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Broker response retained with receipt timestamp and the quote version it responds to.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Responses that cannot be classified are logged and clarified with the broker before action.
generic.Test population: Broker responses logged against issued quotes during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a response is logged without a classification or with requested changes left unitemised.
generic.Exception handling path: Unclassified responses return to the Underwriting Assistant for clarification with the broker.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Broker response classified as accept, decline or counter with each requested change itemised.
generic.Evidence location: CRM opportunity response record linked to the Broker & Agent Portal message.

steps.title: Open the broker response in Broker & Agent Portal
sop: Open the broker response and identify the quote version it responds to.
Download any attachments supplied with the response.
Done when the response and its attachments are open and matched to a quote version.
verify: Compare the quoted reference in the response to the issued quote versions.
Pass when the response is matched to a single issued quote version.

steps.title: Classify the response as accept, decline or counter on the quote record
sop: Select accept, decline or counter on the response classification field.
Do not leave the classification blank where the response is ambiguous.
Seek clarification from the broker where the intent is unclear.
Done when the response carries a classification.
verify: Read the classification against the wording of the broker response.
Pass when the classification is consistent with the response wording.

steps.title: Itemise each requested change in CRM
sop: List each requested change to premium, limit, deductible, wording or commission separately.
Record each item against the CRM (Salesforce/Dynamics) opportunity.
Done when every requested change is itemised.
verify: Compare the itemised list to the broker response text.
Pass when every change named by the broker appears as an item.

steps.title: Capture any stated competitor position verbatim
sop: Copy any competitor premium or terms the broker states, word for word.
Mark the capture as reported rather than verified.
Done when the competitor position is captured verbatim or marked as not stated.
verify: Compare the captured text to the broker message.
Pass when the captured competitor position matches the broker wording.

steps.title: Record the broker stated decision deadline
sop: Record the date by which the broker needs a response.
Create a diary item ahead of that deadline.
Done when the deadline and its diary item are recorded.
verify: Compare the diary date to the recorded broker deadline.
Pass when the diary item falls before the recorded deadline.

steps.title: Set quote status to In negotiation and alert the underwriter
sop: Set the quote status to In negotiation on the quote record.
Confirm the alert has reached the underwriter of record.
Done when the status is set and the underwriter is alerted.
verify: Read the quote status and the alert delivery record.
Pass when the status reads In negotiation and the alert is recorded as delivered.

generic.Defined scope/population: Revised quotes whose negotiated terms exceed the authority under which the original quote was approved.
generic.In-scope period: From agreement of the revised terms to release of the revised quote to the broker.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Revised premium, revised limit, authority test result, approver name, level and date all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of revised quotes exceeding authority equals count of dated re-approvals on file.
