generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Re-approval retained with approver name, level, approval timestamp and the revised quote version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Revised terms released on a superseded approval are logged and re-referred immediately.
generic.Test population: Revised quotes released during the review period after negotiation.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any re-approval is dated before the revised terms were agreed or is below the required level.
generic.Exception handling path: Terms exceeding authority are held unreleased until the Underwriting Director records the approval.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Referral approval dated after the revised terms and granted at the required authority level.
generic.Evidence location: Referral record on the underwriting workstation linked to the policy administration system revised quote.

steps.title: Re-test the revised terms against the authority matrix
sop: Take the revised premium, limit and class after negotiation.
Test each against the current authority matrix.
Record whether any threshold is now exceeded.
Done when the authority re-test result is recorded.
verify: Recompute the authority test from the revised premium and limit.
Pass when the recorded result matches the recomputed test.

steps.title: Raise the referral quoting the original approval reference
sop: Raise a referral in the underwriting workstation against the revised quote.
Quote the original approval reference in the referral.
Highlight the specific terms that changed since that approval.
Done when the referral is raised naming the original approval and the changes.
verify: Read the referral for the original approval reference and the change list.
Pass when the referral names the prior approval and the changed terms.

steps.title: Route the referral to an approver at the correct level
sop: Determine the approval level required by the revised premium and limit.
Route the referral to a named approver holding that level.
Done when the referral sits with a correctly authorised approver.
verify: Compare the approver level to the level required by the revised terms.
Pass when the assigned approver holds at least the required level.

steps.title: Record the approval decision with approver name and date
sop: Record the approval or refusal on the referral in the workstation.
Ensure approver name, level and decision date are stamped.
Done when the referral carries a stamped decision.
verify: Compare the approval date to the date the revised terms were agreed.
Pass when the approval date falls on or after the revised terms agreement date.

steps.title: Carry approval conditions through into the revised quote
sop: List any conditions attached to the approval.
Reflect each condition in the revised quote terms or subjectivities.
Done when every approval condition appears on the revised quote.
verify: Count approval conditions against conditions reflected on the quote.
Pass when every approval condition is reflected in the revised quote.

steps.title: Mark the prior approval superseded in the workstation
sop: Set the prior approval record to superseded so it cannot be relied on.
Link the superseded record to the new approval.
Done when the prior approval reads superseded and links forward.
verify: Read the status of the prior approval and its link to the new approval.
Pass when the prior approval reads superseded and links to the current approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: Revised quotes approved after negotiation that must be re-issued to the broker.
generic.In-scope period: From approval of the revised quote to the new expiry date stated on it.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Version number, new expiry date, change summary, superseded flag and re-attached schedules all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of revised quotes issued equals count of prior versions marked superseded.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each issued version retained with its version number, issue timestamp and issuing user.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Prior versions left bindable after a revision are logged and superseded immediately.
generic.Test population: Revised quotes re-issued to brokers during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any prior version remains bindable after the revised version has been issued.
generic.Exception handling path: Bindable superseded versions are locked by the Underwriting Assistant and reported to the Underwriter.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Latest quote version issued with a new expiry date and the prior version marked superseded.
generic.Evidence location: Broker & Agent Portal issued pack linked to the policy administration system quote version history.

steps.title: Increment the quote version in the policy administration system
sop: Create the revised quote as a new incremented version.
Confirm the prior version remains readable but is not edited.
Done when a new incremented version exists alongside the prior version.
verify: List the quote versions and their numbers.
Pass when the new version number is one greater than the prior version.

steps.title: Set and print the new expiry date on the revised document
sop: Set the new expiry date on the revised quote version.
Regenerate the document so the date is printed on it.
Done when the printed document shows the new expiry date.
verify: Compare the printed expiry date to the date on the quote record.
Pass when the printed and recorded expiry dates agree.

steps.title: Summarise what changed from the previous version in the covering message
sop: List the changes in premium, limits, deductibles and wording since the prior version.
Include the summary in the covering message on Broker & Agent Portal.
Done when the covering message names each change.
verify: Compare the change summary to the difference between the two versions.
Pass when every difference between versions appears in the summary.

steps.title: Mark the prior version superseded so it cannot be bound
sop: Set the prior quote version status to superseded in the policy administration system.
Confirm the bind action is no longer available on that version.
Done when the prior version is superseded and unbindable.
verify: Attempt to open the bind action on the prior version.
Pass when the prior version offers no bind action.

steps.title: Re-attach the revised form and subjectivity schedules
sop: Regenerate the form schedule and subjectivity list for the revised version.
Attach both to the portal pack rather than relying on the earlier attachments.
Done when both schedules are attached to the revised pack.
verify: Open the attached schedules and confirm they carry the revised version reference.
Pass when both attached schedules reference the revised version.

steps.title: Issue the revised pack to the broker on Broker & Agent Portal
sop: Publish the revised pack to the broker on the portal.
Confirm the broker can see the revised version and not only the prior one.
Log the issue against the quote record.
Done when the revised pack is visible to the broker and logged.
verify: View the portal as the broker sees it and check the visible version.
Pass when the broker view shows the revised version as current.

generic.Defined scope/population: Quotes where negotiated terms have been agreed and must be reflected in a new quote version.
generic.In-scope period: From agreement of the negotiated terms to creation of the revised quote version.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Negotiated limits, deductibles, extensions, rating run reference, form schedule and change summary all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Revised premium on the quote equals the output of the linked revised rating run.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Revised quote version retained with its rating run ID, revision timestamp and revising user.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Terms changed without a re-run of rating are logged and re-rated before the version is issued.
generic.Test population: Quote versions created after negotiation during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the revised premium was typed manually rather than taken from a linked rating run.
generic.Exception handling path: Manually typed premiums are rebuilt from a fresh rating run before the revised quote is released.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: New quote version reflects the negotiated terms with a linked rating run producing the premium.
generic.Evidence location: Revised quote version in the policy administration system linked to the Earnix rating run.

steps.title: Key the negotiated limits, deductibles and extensions into the quote
sop: Open a new quote version in the policy administration system.
Enter the negotiated limits, deductibles and agreed extensions.
Done when the negotiated structure is keyed onto the new version.
verify: Compare the keyed structure to the final agreed position on the negotiation log.
Pass when the keyed structure matches the agreed final position.

steps.title: Re-run rating in Earnix Rating & Pricing on the negotiated terms
sop: Update the rating scenario with the negotiated structure.
Run the rating to completion and capture the run ID.
Take the revised premium from the tool output.
Done when a completed run produces the revised premium.
verify: Compare the quote premium to the referenced run output.
Pass when the quote premium equals the linked rating run output.

steps.title: Update the endorsement and form schedule for agreed wording changes
sop: Add, remove or replace forms to reflect the agreed wording changes.
Confirm each new form carries a current filed edition date.
Done when the form schedule reflects the agreed wording.
verify: Compare the revised form schedule to the agreed wording changes on the log.
Pass when every agreed wording change is reflected on the form schedule.

steps.title: Amend the subjectivity list for items waived or added
sop: Remove subjectivities that were waived during negotiation.
Add any new subjectivity agreed as part of the settlement.
Confirm each remaining subjectivity still has an owner and due date.
Done when the subjectivity list reflects the negotiated position.
verify: Compare the subjectivity list to the waived and added items on the log.
Pass when the list matches the negotiated subjectivity position.

steps.title: Record the change summary against the new quote version
sop: Write a summary of every change from the prior version.
Save it against the new version in the policy administration system.
Done when the change summary is saved on the new version.
verify: Compare the summary to the differences between the two versions.
Pass when the summary names every difference between versions.

steps.title: Link the rating run reference to the revised quote version
sop: Enter the Earnix run ID into the rating reference field on the revised version.
Attach the run output to the version.
Done when the revised version carries its rating run reference and output.
verify: Resolve the run reference from the quote back to the Earnix run.
Pass when the referenced run resolves and matches the quoted premium.

generic.Defined scope/population: Strategic accounts in negotiation above the premium threshold that requires management involvement.
generic.In-scope period: From the threshold being triggered to the next broker contact on the account.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Threshold trigger, walk-away price, minimum acceptable terms, portfolio impact and pre-approval all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of accounts above the threshold equals count with a recorded management negotiation position.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Negotiation position entry retained with the approving manager name and the agreement timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Broker contact made before the position was agreed is logged and reviewed by the Underwriting Director.
generic.Test population: Strategic accounts above the premium threshold negotiated during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a walk-away price is absent or was recorded after the next broker contact.
generic.Exception handling path: Positions missing a walk-away price return to the Underwriting Director before any further broker contact.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Recorded walk-away price and minimum acceptable terms approved by the named manager before broker contact.
generic.Evidence location: Negotiation log position entry on the underwriting workstation account record.

steps.title: Check the premium threshold for management involvement on the account
sop: Compare the quoted premium to the management involvement threshold.
Record the trigger result on the negotiation log.
Done when the threshold test result is recorded.
verify: Recompute the threshold test from the quoted premium.
Pass when the recorded trigger matches the recomputed test.

steps.title: State the walk-away price explicitly on the negotiation log
sop: Set the lowest premium the carrier will write the account at.
Record it as the walk-away price on the negotiation log.
Done when a numeric walk-away price is recorded.
verify: Read the recorded walk-away price against the technical premium.
Pass when a numeric walk-away price is recorded with its relation to technical price.

steps.title: State the minimum acceptable terms alongside the price
sop: Set the minimum acceptable limits, deductibles and wording position.
Record which concessions may not be given under any circumstances.
Done when the minimum acceptable terms are recorded.
verify: Read the minimum terms entry for limits, deductibles and wording positions.
Pass when the minimum terms cover limits, deductibles and wording.

steps.title: Consider the portfolio and aggregate impact in Earnix Rating & Pricing
sop: Assess the effect of writing the account on portfolio aggregate and mix.
Read the portfolio position for the class and zone in Earnix.
Record the aggregate consequence on the negotiation log.
Done when the portfolio impact is recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded aggregate impact to the portfolio view for the class.
Pass when the recorded impact reflects the current portfolio position.

steps.title: Pre-approve any authority exception needed to reach the position
sop: Identify whether the agreed position needs an authority exception.
Record the pre-approval with name, level and date in the workstation.
Done when any required exception carries a pre-approval.
verify: Compare the pre-approval level to the exception required by the position.
Pass when the pre-approval is at or above the required level.

steps.title: Record the agreed position before the next broker contact
sop: Save the agreed position and its limits on the negotiation log.
Confirm the entry timestamp precedes the next broker contact.
Done when the position is recorded ahead of the next broker contact.
verify: Compare the position entry timestamp to the next logged broker contact.
Pass when the position entry predates the next broker contact.

generic.Defined scope/population: Expired quotes being re-priced where rate levels or appetite have moved since the original quote.
generic.In-scope period: From the re-price decision to issue of the re-priced quote version.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Rate table version, rate change percentage, appetite changes, withdrawn extensions and new version link all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of re-priced quotes equals count of re-price runs using the current rate table version.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Re-price rating run retained with rate table version, run timestamp and the new quote version reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Re-prices run on a superseded rate table are logged and re-run on the current table.
generic.Test population: Re-priced quote versions created during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the re-price run used a rate table not effective at the new inception date.
generic.Exception handling path: Re-prices on the wrong rate table are rebuilt by the Underwriter before the quote is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Re-price run uses the rate table effective at the new inception date with the rate change recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Re-price rating run in Earnix linked to the policy administration system re-priced quote version.

steps.title: Select the current rate table version for the new effective date in Earnix
sop: Read the new requested inception date from the re-price request.
Select the rate table version effective at that date in Earnix Rating & Pricing.
Done when the scenario is set to the correct rate table version.
verify: Compare the selected rate table effective dates to the new inception date.
Pass when the selected table is effective at the new inception date.

steps.title: Run the re-price and calculate the rate change versus the original quote
sop: Run the re-price scenario to completion.
Compare the re-priced rate to the original quoted rate.
Record the rate change percentage.
Done when the rate change percentage is recorded.
verify: Recompute the rate change from the original and re-priced rates.
Pass when the recorded percentage matches the recomputed change.

steps.title: Reflect appetite shifts in terms as well as price
sop: Compare current appetite guidance to the guidance at the original quote date.
Adjust limits, deductibles or coverage where appetite has tightened.
Record each terms change driven by appetite.
Done when appetite shifts are reflected in the terms.
verify: Compare the re-priced terms to the current appetite guidance.
Pass when the re-priced terms comply with current appetite guidance.

steps.title: Remove withdrawn coverage extensions from the re-priced offer
sop: List extensions offered originally that are no longer available.
Remove each from the re-priced quote in the policy administration system.
Note the removal so it can be explained to the broker.
Done when no withdrawn extension remains on the offer.
verify: Compare the re-priced extension list to the currently available extension set.
Pass when every extension on the re-priced quote is currently available.

steps.title: Save the re-priced figures as a new quote version referencing the original
sop: Create a new quote version holding the re-priced figures.
Reference the original quote version on the new version.
Done when the new version exists and references the original.
verify: Open the new version and follow the reference to the original.
Pass when the new version resolves back to the original quote version.

steps.title: Record the rate table version and run ID on the re-priced version
sop: Stamp the rate table version and Earnix run ID onto the re-priced quote version.
Attach the re-price run output to the version.
Done when the version carries the rate table version, run ID and output.
verify: Resolve the run ID and check the rate table version it used.
Pass when the referenced run used the stamped rate table version.

generic.Defined scope/population: Quotes where the broker has confirmed that coverage is no longer being pursued.
generic.In-scope period: From the broker confirmation to the archiving of the complete quote pack.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Broker confirmation, closure status, reason code, cancelled diary items and retention date all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of quotes closed as dead equals count of archived packs carrying a retention date.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Archived pack retained with closure timestamp, closing user and the document versions included.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Quotes closed without broker confirmation are logged and confirmation is sought before archiving.
generic.Test population: Quotes closed as dead during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any archived pack lacks a closure reason code or a retention and destruction date.
generic.Exception handling path: Packs missing a retention date return to the Underwriting Assistant before the archive is treated as complete.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Archived quote pack carries a closure reason code and a stamped retention date.
generic.Evidence location: Archived pack in OpenText Document Mgmt referenced from the policy administration system quote record.

steps.title: Attach the broker confirmation that cover is not being pursued
sop: Save the broker message confirming the account will not proceed.
Attach it to the quote record in the policy administration system.
Done when the confirmation is attached to the quote record.
verify: Open the attachment and confirm it states cover is not being pursued.
Pass when the attached confirmation states the account will not proceed.

steps.title: Set the quote status to Closed or Lost with a reason code
sop: Set the quote status to Closed or Lost.
Select the closure reason code from the controlled list.
Done when status and reason code are both set.
verify: Read the status and reason code on the quote record.
Pass when the status is closed and a controlled reason code is selected.

steps.title: Cancel open diary items and follow-up tasks
sop: List the open diary items and follow-up tasks on the quote.
Cancel each so the account stops appearing on chase lists.
Done when no open diary item remains on the quote.
verify: Re-run the open task list for the quote.
Pass when the quote returns no open diary items or tasks.

steps.title: Assemble the full quote pack for archiving
sop: Gather the quote document, rating run output and broker correspondence.
Check every issued quote version is included.
Done when the complete pack is assembled.
verify: Compare the pack contents to the documents held on the quote record.
Pass when the pack contains every document held on the quote record.

steps.title: Move the pack to the archive folder in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Move the assembled pack into the archive location for closed quotes.
Index it by insured name, broker and quote reference.
Done when the pack sits in the archive indexed by quote reference.
verify: Search the archive by quote reference and open the pack.
Pass when the pack is retrievable by its quote reference.

steps.title: Stamp the retention and destruction date on the archived record
sop: Apply the retention class from the records schedule.
Confirm the destruction date is derived and stamped on the record.
Write the archive reference back onto the quote record.
Done when retention class, destruction date and archive reference are all recorded.
verify: Recompute the destruction date from the closure date and retention class.
Pass when the stamped destruction date matches the retention schedule.

generic.Defined scope/population: Quotes that have passed their expiry date and need the broker intent established.
generic.In-scope period: From the quote expiry date to the recorded broker intent and next action.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Broker contact date, person spoken to, stated intent, risk changes and next action all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of expired quotes on the working list equals count with a logged broker contact.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Contact log retained with call date, contact name and the quote version discussed.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Expired quotes with no broker response after the chase cadence are logged for lapse processing.
generic.Test population: Expired quotes worked during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any expired quote is left without a logged contact attempt or a recorded intent.
generic.Exception handling path: Unreachable brokers trigger a final written request before the quote proceeds to lapse.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Logged broker contact on the expired quote with the broker intent recorded and a next action created.
generic.Evidence location: Contact activity on the CRM opportunity linked to the Broker & Agent Portal quote record.

steps.title: Work the expired quote list in premium and expiry order
sop: Run the expired quote list from the workstation reporting view.
Sort it by premium size and then expiry date.
Done when the working order for the expired list is set.
verify: Check the working list ordering against premium and expiry values.
Pass when the list is ordered by premium size and expiry date.

steps.title: Contact the broker through Broker & Agent Portal or by phone
sop: Contact the broker handling the expired quote.
Reference the quote number and its expiry date.
Done when contact is made or a documented attempt is recorded.
verify: Read the contact record for the quote reference and contact channel.
Pass when the contact record names the quote and the channel used.

steps.title: Ask the broker to choose renew, re-price or withdraw
sop: Put the three options to the broker explicitly.
Do not accept an ambiguous answer as an intent.
Done when the broker has chosen one of the three options.
verify: Read the recorded intent against the three permitted options.
Pass when the recorded intent is one of renew, re-price or withdraw.

steps.title: Capture any change in the risk or requested inception date
sop: Ask whether the risk, exposure or requested inception date has changed.
Record any change on the quote record for the re-price to use.
Done when risk and inception changes are captured or confirmed as none.
verify: Read the captured changes against the original quote data.
Pass when changes are recorded or the record states no change was reported.

steps.title: Record the broker answer with date and the person spoken to in CRM
sop: Create the contact activity on the CRM (Salesforce/Dynamics) opportunity.
Record the date, the person spoken to and the stated intent.
Done when the CRM activity holds the date, contact name and intent.
verify: Open the CRM activity and check all three fields are populated.
Pass when the activity records date, contact name and stated intent.

steps.title: Create the next action immediately after the contact
sop: Create a re-price task or a closure task depending on the stated intent.
Assign the task to a named owner with a due date.
Done when the next action task exists with an owner and due date.
verify: Compare the created task type to the recorded broker intent.
Pass when the task type matches the recorded intent and has a named owner.

generic.Defined scope/population: Re-priced quotes whose premium differs from the original quote and requires a documented rationale.
generic.In-scope period: From completion of the re-price run to issue of the re-priced quote version.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Percentage change, rate driver, exposure driver, terms driver, new loss activity and filed revision all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of the stated rate, exposure and terms drivers equals the total percentage change recorded.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rationale retained against the re-priced version with author name and rationale date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Re-prices issued without a rationale are logged and the rationale is added before broker issue.
generic.Test population: Re-priced quote versions issued during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the rationale omits the percentage change or does not split the change into drivers.
generic.Exception handling path: Incomplete rationales return to the Underwriter before the re-priced quote goes to the broker.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Rationale stating the percentage change and its drivers attached to the re-priced quote version.
generic.Evidence location: Rationale note on the re-priced quote version in the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: State the percentage change versus the original quoted premium
sop: Read the original and re-priced premiums from the quote versions.
Calculate the percentage change between them.
Record the percentage in the rationale note.
Done when the percentage change is stated in the note.
verify: Recompute the percentage change from the two premiums.
Pass when the stated percentage matches the recomputed change.

steps.title: Split the drivers between rate, exposure and terms change in Earnix
sop: Use the Earnix comparison view to isolate rate, exposure and terms effects.
Record the contribution of each driver to the total change.
Done when each driver contribution is recorded.
verify: Sum the recorded driver contributions and compare to the total change.
Pass when the summed drivers equal the total percentage change.

steps.title: Reference any new loss activity since the original quote
sop: Check the refreshed loss runs for claims arising since the original quote.
Reference any new claim and its effect on the re-price.
State explicitly where there has been no new loss activity.
Done when new loss activity is referenced or confirmed as none.
verify: Compare the referenced claims to the refreshed loss run.
Pass when every claim on the refreshed loss run is reflected in the note.

steps.title: Cite the filed rate revision or table change where it drives the movement
sop: Identify any filed rate revision effective between the two quote dates.
Cite the revision reference in the rationale.
Done when any applicable filed revision is cited.
verify: Resolve the cited revision reference to the filed rate change record.
Pass when the cited revision resolves to a filed rate change.

steps.title: Write the rationale note in the underwriting workstation
sop: Assemble the percentage, drivers, loss activity and filed revision into one note.
Sign the note with author name and date.
Done when the complete signed rationale note exists.
verify: Read the note for all four elements and the signature.
Pass when the note carries all four elements with an author and date.

steps.title: Attach the rationale to the re-priced quote version
sop: Attach the note to the re-priced version rather than the original.
Confirm the note is reachable from the version record.
Done when the rationale is attached to the re-priced version.
verify: Open the re-priced version and follow the link to the rationale.
Pass when the rationale opens from the re-priced quote version.

generic.Defined scope/population: Re-priced quotes approved for release that must replace an expired quote with the broker.
generic.In-scope period: From approval of the re-priced version to the new expiry date stated on it.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Version number, new expiry date, premium change statement, updated schedules and diary date all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of re-priced quotes issued equals count of expired versions marked replaced.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issued re-priced pack retained with version number, issue timestamp and issuing user.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Re-priced quotes issued without stating the premium change are logged and clarified to the broker.
generic.Test population: Re-priced quotes issued to brokers during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the expired version remains presented to the broker as current after the re-price is issued.
generic.Exception handling path: Expired versions still visible are withdrawn by the Underwriting Assistant on the portal the same day.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Revised quote available to the broker with a new expiry date replacing the expired version.
generic.Evidence location: Broker & Agent Portal issued pack linked to the policy administration system quote version history.

steps.title: Set the new expiry date and version number on the re-priced quote
sop: Create the re-priced quote as a new version in the policy administration system.
Set the new expiry date and regenerate the document.
Done when the version carries a new number and expiry date.
verify: Compare the printed expiry date and version to the quote record.
Pass when the document version and expiry date match the record.

steps.title: State in the covering message that the original quote is replaced
sop: Write the covering message stating the original quote has expired.
State that this version replaces it in full.
Done when the replacement statement is in the covering message.
verify: Read the covering message for the expiry and replacement statement.
Pass when the message states the original has expired and is replaced.

steps.title: State the premium change versus the expired quote up front
sop: State the premium change in amount and percentage at the top of the message.
Reference the rationale drivers briefly so the broker can explain it onward.
Done when the premium change is stated up front in the message.
verify: Recompute the stated change from the two quoted premiums.
Pass when the stated change matches the recomputed difference.

steps.title: Attach the updated subjectivities and form schedule
sop: Regenerate the subjectivity list and form schedule for the re-priced version.
Attach both to the pack on Broker & Agent Portal.
Done when both updated schedules are attached.
verify: Open the attached schedules and check they reference the re-priced version.
Pass when both schedules reference the re-priced version.

steps.title: Publish the re-priced pack to the broker on Broker & Agent Portal
sop: Publish the re-priced pack so the broker sees it as the current quote.
Withdraw or supersede the expired version on the portal.
Done when the broker view shows only the re-priced version as current.
verify: View the portal as the broker and check which version reads current.
Pass when only the re-priced version is presented as current.

steps.title: Reset the diary to the new expiry date
sop: Cancel the diary items tied to the expired quote.
Create a follow-up diary item dated before the new expiry.
Done when a single open diary item points at the new expiry date.
verify: List open diary items for the quote and read their due dates.
Pass when exactly one open diary item is dated before the new expiry.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open quotes with a stated expiry date falling within or before the next fourteen days.
generic.In-scope period: The review cycle covering quotes expiring in the next fourteen days plus those already overdue.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Quote reference, expiry date, premium, assigned underwriter and chase action all populated on each row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of rows on the expiry report equals count of at-risk quotes assigned a chase action.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dated expiry review list retained with the report run parameters and the reviewer identity.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Quotes with no assigned underwriter are logged and assigned before the review is closed.
generic.Test population: Expiry review lists produced during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any at-risk quote on the report has no chase action or no assigned underwriter.
generic.Exception handling path: Unassigned at-risk quotes escalate to the UW Operations Manager for same-day assignment.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Dated expiry review with every at-risk quote flagged and assigned to a named underwriter.
generic.Evidence location: Expiry review list saved on the underwriting workstation reporting view.

steps.title: Run the open quote report filtered to the next fourteen days
sop: Run the open quote report in the underwriting workstation.
Filter to quotes with an expiry date within the next fourteen days.
Done when the fourteen day expiry list is produced.
verify: Check the filter parameters recorded on the report output.
Pass when the report parameters show the fourteen day expiry window.

steps.title: List quotes already past expiry separately as overdue
sop: Run a second extract for quotes already past their expiry date.
Keep the overdue list separate from the upcoming expiry list.
Done when a distinct overdue list exists.
verify: Check no quote appears on both the upcoming and overdue lists.
Pass when the two lists are mutually exclusive.

steps.title: Cross-check the lists against the policy administration system quote statuses
sop: Compare each listed quote status in the policy administration system.
Remove quotes already bound or closed from the at-risk lists.
Done when the lists hold only genuinely open quotes.
verify: Read the status of a sample of listed quotes in the policy administration system.
Pass when no bound or closed quote remains on the at-risk lists.

steps.title: Assign each at-risk quote to its underwriter with a chase action
sop: Assign each at-risk quote to its underwriter of record.
Create a chase action against each with a due date.
Done when every at-risk quote has an assignment and a chase action.
verify: Count at-risk quotes against chase actions created.
Pass when every at-risk quote carries an assigned chase action.

steps.title: Prioritise large-premium quotes in the working order
sop: Sort the at-risk lists so the largest premium quotes are worked first.
Confirm the highest value quotes have the earliest chase dates.
Done when the working order reflects premium size.
verify: Compare chase due dates to premium size across the list.
Pass when the largest premium quotes carry the earliest chase dates.

steps.title: Record the review date and the list worked
sop: Save the reviewed list with the review date and reviewer name.
Record any quote left unworked so the gap is visible next cycle.
Done when the dated review record is saved.
verify: Open the saved review and check the date, reviewer and unworked list.
Pass when the saved review carries a date, reviewer and any unworked items.
